chapters.title: Chapter 263: Kent vs Sword Saintess Val (3)
paragraphs: "Sword Drilling," the Saintess murmured. The three flying swords in the air shifted and merged, their tips touching to form a spinning drill.
Her profound qi was coating the tip ,making it appear deadly.
The drill shot toward Kent, its speed blinding.
The Saintess wasn’t joking with the brat anymore, so she unleashed a rather powerful attack she had created years ago and mastered to a level she could boldly use in battle.
Kent’s eyes narrowed, and he blinked away, intending to evade the attack, but the next second, the drill reappeared on his left.
It appeared so sudden that he had no time to evade, so he made the only move he had—he defended.
Kent coated his sword with sword qi and swung at the drill, aiming to deflect it.
But just as his blade was about to meet the spinning drill, it split into three separate swords, simultaneously attacking from three different directions.
The drill was just a trojan horse. The main attack was the three swords breaking away when they got close to their target.
Kent was caught off guard, but his reflexes kicked in. He twisted his body, narrowly avoiding the worst of the attack.
Still, a shallow cut appeared on his forehead, a thin line of blood trickling down. The sword wanted to take his throat away, but he was fast enough to evade.
He wiped the blood away with the back of his hand, his expression darkening. "Clever," he muttered, his grip tightening on his sword. "But not clever enough."
"Rapid Slash"
Kent swung his sword, and this time, 350 sword arcs buzzed into existence, causing every last one watching to widen their eyes in shock.
"What the fuck is going on?" a disciple shouted, watching the Saintess’s eyes darken as she sustained a few cuts from the arcs she couldn’t defend against.
The attack was simply too deadly. Kent was using both intent and qi, so the arcs weren’t simple in any way.
Kent’s motivation for mastering this technique was to counter the clone. However, he failed to notice that the Saintess lacked the skill set to counter his.
Having a superior cultivation base is good, but so is having a higher grade and tier skills. Kent’s skill is divine grade, and he had mastered it using a level 6 Enhanced sword intent.
This alone is enough to tell you just how deadly the attacks had become.
She is stronger and faster, but she doesn’t have the required skills to counter his attacks.
She managed to defend herself by using a cyclone-type skill. But now that Kent had infused intent into his sword qi, the attack became incredibly lethal.
It rained down on her, causing everyone, including the two gate masters watching, to widen their eyes in astonishment.
Kent unleashed the Rpaid slash again, sending 350 arcs at the Saintess, who was getting pushed back gradually.
The Gate master now wore a shocked expression on her face. She could tell the Saintess was nearing her end simply because she wasn’t able to keep up with the attacks raining down on her.
In fact, keeping up was an underestimate.
She was practically helpless against them.
The reason is simple.
The blades raining down on her are just too much to counter. Kent is using just 350; however, the force behind those 350 isn’t something that can be considered simple.
"You are probably regretting looking down on him," Gate Master Camilla, who was equally shocked, said.
She may have placed her bet on Kent winning, but now that he is indeed doing the winning, she couldn’t believe it.
He was fighting a Sword Saint for fuck sake.
Who is a Sword Saint?
Someone who had mastered the sword to a stage where they earned three enlightenment, transformed their sword qi and intent from Enhanced stage to Profound stage.
Someone whose understanding of the sword is several times stronger than Kent’s. So, how is he doing that?
Of course, Kent may now be experiencing this thanks to his memories of Jest, but he hadn’t reached the level of putting a sword Saint in that corner.
In fact, she is someone Kent shouldn’t even have lasted a minute against.
To become a Saint or Saintess in the Kingdom, one had to face challenges from hundreds of swordsmen. The battle to determine that is several times aggressive
So whoever gets the title of a Saint or Saintess of any weapons path is respected, and even the Kings would have to obey and listen to them.
Perhaps, after reviewing all this, that was why the Gate master came to the conclusion that Kent wouldn’t last a minute against Saintess Val.
The last time she saw Kent was a day ago when he came out of the Sword Garden.
She saw he had gained some insight into things, but she wasn’t considering that, considering it had only been a couple of days, and he didn’t even go to the Tower as she suggested.
So she wasn’t expecting much from him.
Of course, if only she knew it had been 24 productive days for Kent inside his tower.
He spent those days further taking his Fusion technique to 95% and his rapid slash skill to the peak while even the sword mind cultivation was at 4600 sword plays.

He had transformed these past days, and thanks to his ladies, he was able to add 2,000 more points to his agility, enabling him to keep up with the Saintess, who just couldn’t understand how he was moving.
Whenever she got close to attack, he would just blink away from existence.
This wasn’t how she had envisioned the battle going.
She was shocked and panicking, considering she was getting hurt by the second. Kent wasn’t holding back on her at all.
The audience arent doing much better, considering the battle hadn’t even reached an hour yet, but Kent had taken control of the fight.
The two gate masters were also in a state of shock, watching the golden sword arcs buzzing like bees as they rained down on the Saintess. Her defense was gradually crumbling.
The last person who was shocked was Kent himself.
It’s true he knew the fusion would be strong, but he never expected his level 6 Enhanced Sword Qi and intent to be this monstrous.
The additional 2,000 points had boosted his stamina, so he wasn’t feeling any discomfort from using the skill so extensively.
However, the shock came from the fact that, despite using the skill, the outcome wasn’t what he had anticipated.
He had to give it to the Saintess; she was good—really talented—to the point where she nearly ended the battle a couple of times.
Her Profound Qi and intent were at the level 2 stage. However, she couldn’t counter the sword arcs.
This meant that although Kent was at the Enhanced stage, the true foundation of his intent and Qi was in no way simple. In fact, he could tell his intent should be nearing the Profound stage by now.
He was pushing the Saintess back with every swing of his sword, and right now, the whole arena was quiet, shock written on their faces.
The only sound coming was the buzzing sound of the golden sword arcs.

sentences.text: "Sword Drilling," the Saintess murmured.
The three flying swords in the air shifted and merged, their tips touching to form a spinning drill.
Her profound qi was coating the tip ,making it appear deadly.
The drill shot toward Kent, its speed blinding.
The Saintess wasn’t joking with the brat anymore, so she unleashed a rather powerful attack she had created years ago and mastered to a level she could boldly use in battle.
Kent’s eyes narrowed, and he blinked away, intending to evade the attack, but the next second, the drill reappeared on his left.
It appeared so sudden that he had no time to evade, so he made the only move he had—he defended.
Kent coated his sword with sword qi and swung at the drill, aiming to deflect it.
But just as his blade was about to meet the spinning drill, it split into three separate swords, simultaneously attacking from three different directions.
The drill was just a trojan horse.
The main attack was the three swords breaking away when they got close to their target.
Kent was caught off guard, but his reflexes kicked in.
He twisted his body, narrowly avoiding the worst of the attack.
Still, a shallow cut appeared on his forehead, a thin line of blood trickling down.
The sword wanted to take his throat away, but he was fast enough to evade.
He wiped the blood away with the back of his hand, his expression darkening.
"Clever," he muttered, his grip tightening on his sword.
"But not clever enough."
"Rapid Slash"
Kent swung his sword, and this time, 350 sword arcs buzzed into existence, causing every last one watching to widen their eyes in shock.
"What the fuck is going on?" a disciple shouted, watching the Saintess’s eyes darken as she sustained a few cuts from the arcs she couldn’t defend against.
The attack was simply too deadly.
Kent was using both intent and qi, so the arcs weren’t simple in any way.
Kent’s motivation for mastering this technique was to counter the clone.
However, he failed to notice that the Saintess lacked the skill set to counter his.
Having a superior cultivation base is good, but so is having a higher grade and tier skills.
Kent’s skill is divine grade, and he had mastered it using a level 6 Enhanced sword intent.
This alone is enough to tell you just how deadly the attacks had become.
She is stronger and faster, but she doesn’t have the required skills to counter his attacks.
She managed to defend herself by using a cyclone-type skill.
But now that Kent had infused intent into his sword qi, the attack became incredibly lethal.
It rained down on her, causing everyone, including the two gate masters watching, to widen their eyes in astonishment.
Kent unleashed the Rpaid slash again, sending 350 arcs at the Saintess, who was getting pushed back gradually.
The Gate master now wore a shocked expression on her face.
She could tell the Saintess was nearing her end simply because she wasn’t able to keep up with the attacks raining down on her.
In fact, keeping up was an underestimate.
She was practically helpless against them.
The reason is simple.
The blades raining down on her are just too much to counter.
Kent is using just 350; however, the force behind those 350 isn’t something that can be considered simple.
"You are probably regretting looking down on him," Gate Master Camilla, who was equally shocked, said.
She may have placed her bet on Kent winning, but now that he is indeed doing the winning, she couldn’t believe it.
He was fighting a Sword Saint for fuck sake.
Who is a Sword Saint?
Someone who had mastered the sword to a stage where they earned three enlightenment, transformed their sword qi and intent from Enhanced stage to Profound stage.
Someone whose understanding of the sword is several times stronger than Kent’s.
So, how is he doing that?
Of course, Kent may now be experiencing this thanks to his memories of Jest, but he hadn’t reached the level of putting a sword Saint in that corner.
In fact, she is someone Kent shouldn’t even have lasted a minute against.
To become a Saint or Saintess in the Kingdom, one had to face challenges from hundreds of swordsmen.
The battle to determine that is several times aggressive
So whoever gets the title of a Saint or Saintess of any weapons path is respected, and even the Kings would have to obey and listen to them.
Perhaps, after reviewing all this, that was why the Gate master came to the conclusion that Kent wouldn’t last a minute against Saintess Val.
The last time she saw Kent was a day ago when he came out of the Sword Garden.
She saw he had gained some insight into things, but she wasn’t considering that, considering it had only been a couple of days, and he didn’t even go to the Tower as she suggested.
So she wasn’t expecting much from him.
Of course, if only she knew it had been 24 productive days for Kent inside his tower.
He spent those days further taking his Fusion technique to 95% and his rapid slash skill to the peak while even the sword mind cultivation was at 4600 sword plays.

He had transformed these past days, and thanks to his ladies, he was able to add 2,000 more points to his agility, enabling him to keep up with the Saintess, who just couldn’t understand how he was moving.
Whenever she got close to attack, he would just blink away from existence.
This wasn’t how she had envisioned the battle going.
She was shocked and panicking, considering she was getting hurt by the second.
Kent wasn’t holding back on her at all.
The audience arent doing much better, considering the battle hadn’t even reached an hour yet, but Kent had taken control of the fight.
The two gate masters were also in a state of shock, watching the golden sword arcs buzzing like bees as they rained down on the Saintess.
Her defense was gradually crumbling.
The last person who was shocked was Kent himself.
It’s true he knew the fusion would be strong, but he never expected his level 6 Enhanced Sword Qi and intent to be this monstrous.
The additional 2,000 points had boosted his stamina, so he wasn’t feeling any discomfort from using the skill so extensively.
However, the shock came from the fact that, despite using the skill, the outcome wasn’t what he had anticipated.
He had to give it to the Saintess; she was good—really talented—to the point where she nearly ended the battle a couple of times.
Her Profound Qi and intent were at the level 2 stage.
However, she couldn’t counter the sword arcs.
This meant that although Kent was at the Enhanced stage, the true foundation of his intent and Qi was in no way simple.
In fact, he could tell his intent should be nearing the Profound stage by now.
He was pushing the Saintess back with every swing of his sword, and right now, the whole arena was quiet, shock written on their faces.
The only sound coming was the buzzing sound of the golden sword arcs.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Monstrous Talent
paragraphs: "This is bad," Gate Master Camilla said. "If this brat somehow wins this battle, then, per their bet, the Saintess will become his servant.
This wouldn’t be received well by the Evaslating Immortal Sword Sect. In fact, they will double down their efforts to kill him now."
Gate Master Mara nodded.
They were already aware of the spreading rumors indicating that a monster swordsman had appeared inside the Sword Gate of the Divine Palace Sect.
So, though they didn’t show it, they were extra careful, ensuring no one got closer to Kent. They couldn’t afford to let him fall into the hands of those tigers.
Kent was like a key they were now planning to use to discover the true identity of the Sect Master. So he could not die.
However, from the looks of things now, Kent might just be falling into the hands of these tigers if he indeed went ahead and defeated this Saintess.
And from the look of things, he was indeed heading in that direction. The Saintess wasn’t having much success with her attacks connecting.
Her tendency to make comments that could break one’s resolve during battles was halted from the moment they crossed swords.
Right now, she was hurt in multiple places. Kent was also hurt but was healing much faster since he was a body cultivator and a Dragon.
Those wounds are healing as he moves and sustains new ones.
"Should we stop him?" Gate Master Camilla asked again.
She may be the gate master from the Spear Gate, but she knew she would have to support her friend when it came down to it.
"No," Gate Master Mara unexpectedly declined.
"Are you being serious? Kent is going to anger a lot of people if he defeats the saintess and makes her his servant.
Do you really want that to happen? Are you perhaps hoping they will take care of him for you?" she asked, but Gate Master Mara just smirked.

"He is a disciple of the Sword Gate. If they want, they can come. It’s been a long time since I fought seriously. So, wouldn’t this be a chance for me to stretch my legs and arms?" she said with a cold smile.
For a moment, Gate Master Camilla shuddered.
She may have forgotten that she was now sitting beside the one who was once hailed as the genius of the entire Human Continent.
Someone who fought in many battles and defeated those stronger than her. Someone whom many sect masters feared.
Someone who could be utterly unreasonable if she wanted to be. This made Camilla want to remind her that not one, but many, would be coming for Kent.
But she knew her character, so she chose to keep quiet and watch as Mara smiled sinisterly, looking at the brat who had only seemed to make her life miserable ever since he stepped into the sect.
That same brat was now taking care of a Rude Saintess, with the only outcome being more trouble. It was like Kent was built for trouble.
’At least he is putting the name of the Sword Gate on the map. But is he ready for all the attention?’ she wondered. And, as if Kent had heard her, he moved back and sheathed his sword.
The Saintess wasn’t looking too good at the moment.
"Dare I ask: were you hoping to claim this battle in the bag? You might have thought this battle was as good as over, considering I am a Sword Grandmaster.
But you probably must be regretting that decision now. Don’t worry. I am not done yet. I am not one to talk between battles, but I just want to say this:
If you have any trump cards, now might be the time to use them, for I am about to end the battle. I would love to see you struggle to the bitter end."
Kent smiled, hoping she would listen to his words.
The reason he taunted her was that if she indeed brought out all her trump cards and he still defeated her, immediately after the battle, he would face the Sword Bridge again.
So he moved and swung his sword again. This time, the rapid slash didn’t activate. Instead, the [72 String Sovereign Strike] did.
Instead of thin strings, they now appeared like chains with pointed tips.
Seventy-two of them sped toward the Saintess, who immediately unleashed an attack that created small swords from her sword qi, defending against the 72 String Sovereign Strikes.
Kent didn’t allow her to rest and unleashed the Elemental Lord, summoning a flaming lion large enough to shake anyone’s heart. It sped toward her.
By the time she was done defending that, Kent unleashed the [True Despair sword strike], which landed on her body, pushing her back by a few meters.
Her body shuddered as the feeling of fear and despair ran into her mind.
Then, 350 sword arcs filled the air.
This time, instead of using her sword to defend herself, she tapped a necklace around her neck, causing her clothes to change into armor.
The attacks landed on it, pushing her back, but the damage was minimal.
"Good, then why don’t we end the battle," Kent said with a smile. The saintess has finally used her strongest defense, meaning Kent could also use his ultimate move.
He swung his sword, and 450 sword arcs appeared. The air was painted golden, and for a moment, the Saintess saw her life flash before her eyes.
And then it happened.

All 450 sword arcs rained down on her, causing her to black out. The next second, she was outside the arena. The entire space shuddered under the attack, causing many, if not all, to break into a cold sweat.
The battle was over, and Kent was left standing inside the arena, but nobody was cheering. No, they all had their eyes on Kent, who had already sheathed his sword.
The attacks he used—none of them could understand just how monstrous they were.
The sword arcs shouldn’t be that numerous for a normal sword skill, so what was the grade of the technique he had used?
Of course, if only they knew this was a skill designed and developed by a goddess, they would probably finally understand just how a Grandmaster could defeat a Saintess.
But the battle was over.
Kent emerged victorious, but he wasn’t happy.
The Saintess was in shock, so she passed out.
The Gate Master appeared beside her and, after giving Kent a nod that might have carried some respect, took her away.
Kent turned to the audience and gave them the "bye, bitches" look before teleporting away.
The battle was over and what followed next was the news that would break the kingdom and cause many minds to flip.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Shocking the Kingdom, Escalation
paragraphs: The battle was over, and two days had gone by; however, nothing like calm was observed, for nobody was able to keep their calm.
Ten minutes after the battle, news reached all the other gates about the defeat of a sword Saintess by a mere Grandmaster swordsman.
The name that came with this shocking news was Kent, The same brat whose name never left anyone’s lips this past day. Kent had basically become a hot top in the sect, and now, he had struck again.
There were videos, too, so while many quickly shut down the news, the videos weren’t easily dismissed.
This shook their head, and for a moment there, the other gates could tell the sword gate had received a monster who had no equal.
Four hours after the battle, news had already begun travelling to the other cities and sects and even going beyond the borders of the Athea Kingdom.
Kent defeated the sword saintess from the Everlasting Immortal Sword sect in a sword duel, and from how people exaggerate it, Kent did it all with complete dominance.
He defeated someone who has access and control over profound qi and intent. That just doesn’t make sense. Nobody could tell just what he was made of or where his skills came from.
But it was clear to all that Kent, the purple-haired brat who seemed to only know trouble, was now someone who could not be ignored.
Within a day, the news reached almost everyone. The duel, the defeat of Saintess Val and the bet made before the duel had reached everyone.
The enranged ones had already started making their way toward the Divine Palace sect, while the shameless ones were coming with all kinds of gifts just to get in Kent’s good grace.
They all want to suck up to him or kill him.
The enraged elders of the Everlasting Immortal Sword sect are currently heading toward the divine palace sect, only a couple of hours out.
Meanwhile, after a day, Saintess Val woke up with a pale expression. She was resting in the Gate master’s abode, so when she woke up, the first face she saw was Gate Master Mara.
"You are finally up. Do you remember anything?" Gate master Mara asked. She was just checking if the new disciple of her gate was alright in the head.
She would be lying if she said this was something she saw coming. But now, the Saintess lost the bet, and so, she would become Kent’s servant, making her a disciple of her sword gate if Kent wanted.
"I lost," Saintess Val said with an expression that said she was finally coming to terms with her loss.
"Indeed. You lost to the brat and it wasn’t as we all expected it. What happened? "Gate Master Mara asked. "You were in your element, so what changed?"
"Everything changed when he drew his sword. It was like before he drew his sword. He was just an average swordsman; however, the moment it came out of the sheath, his presence began to rise.
And the strange part is that his presence keeps rising through the entire battle. This is my first time encountering something this bizarre."
The Saintess sang like a bird, not out of shock but out of respect. The lady sitting in front of her wasn’t someone she could disrespect like she did with the elders.
The gate master is a Sword Sage, someone nearing the ranks of a Sword King, so she had to be respected around her.
But she also spoke out of shock, considering as they fought, she seemed to notice Kent kept getting stronger, adapting to her speed, and his stamina never seemed to go down.

"That is indeed strange, but that shouldn’t be enough to harm you. There hard to be something else at play," She said, remembering the buzzing sound of the golden sword arcs that rained down on the saintess.
"His skills are unusual. Even your sect sword skill was different when he used it. And during the end of the battle, he used a skill that made me become scared for a second there.
Perhaps that was what caused my downfall in the first place."
She sighs and bends her head, contemplating what this all entails. She lost, and according to the bet, she would become his servant.

This was an insult to her, considering she is a Saintess. She is someone King listens to, so the idea of becoming someone’s servant wasn’t something she wanted. But now, she had to think of her life and where it’s headed.
If only she knew that even as a servant to the son of the universe, she was meant to gain more than she could think of.
But she doesn’t know that. She doesn’t know that the only servant currently under the purple-haired brat has already received a true name and is destined to rise to the peak with him.
Kent picked that bet mainly because of the quest he received right before the duel. It was similar to the one he received for the Spear Saintess.
He just doesn’t understand why the universe was making him do all this, but he was grateful for the end results and the gifts that came along the way.
So now, the first quest was over when he defeated her. The second, however, would be determined based on her next choice.
But while the entire kingdom was flipping over Kent’s win against the Saintess, the man in question was lying on his back while a beautiful damsel bounced up and down on his lap.
Ingrid was riding him like a cowgirl, and from the look on his face, one could tell he was enjoying the ride to his heart’s content.
Ingrid came out of seclusion a few hours ago after spending close to a day just talking to her big sister, Vexthra, and then some absorbing the Ambrosia apple.
She had to spend those hours with her goddess big sister so she could develop a cultivation technique for her. Then, she had to absorb the Ambrosia apple her master gave her.
Her master then had to enter another seclusion, where she would receive her cultivation technique now that she had also finished upgrading her spirit root.
A two-tier upgrade on her side.
In the end, she became happy, the same as her master, who was talking to Vexthra while listening to the moans of her disciple, who had now become much happier than when she entered seclusion.
However, since Neomi was talking to her big sister, the disciple would take over.
Of course, none of them knew Kent had just defeated a saintess, and he would soon be receiving representatives from the King.
Basically, Kent unknowingly started a revolution that will spark many debates for the days, weeks and months to come.
This also means the tigers and demons hiding just out of sight will make their move against him soon.
Kent, however, was now ready to handle something he just couldn’t put off.
Right now, the only thing in his heart was to find out who this mysterious Nara was. He must do that before the auction, considering a lot will happen in the coming days and during the auction.

Do it just like you did for Selene." He gave the Path of the Void to her.
"Also, use this to create a path for Neomi.
And don’t worry, you have free access to my tower points so make them look good."
Kent gave her the path he got for the Saintess.
Right now, aside from Selene, Ingrid and Neomi had received a path.
However, they weren’t the only ones; Lilian had also received a path.
This reward was from the first quest he received, the quest for the duel between him and Saintess Val.
He won, so the rewards for the first quest were now his to claim.
The quest simply wanted him to challenge the Saintess to a duel and win.
⟪Quest Name: Rehabilitating a Saintess ⟫
⟪Quest Type: Chain (1/4)⟫
⟪Quest Difficulty: Very⟫
→ Saintess Val is gunning for your head, so what will you do about it?
Would you allow her to win, or will you man up and stop her?
→ If your answer is manly, then man up and challenge her to a duel and win.
→ But before winning, make sure you place a serious bet, considering she will ask for a bet.
→ You must place the stake that ’if she lost the duel, she would become your servant.’
⟪Rewards: ⟫
→ 1,000,000 Tower Points
→ The path of the Ice and First Elemental Mage
→ Dungeon Master Token
The first quest on that chain quest was just the best.
All he had to do was challenge her and win.
Thankfully, he did win, and now, he received a path for Lilian, who is a mage with both Ice and Fire elemental affinity.
This will also allow Lilian to grow from walking a path that will one day turn her into a powerful elemental mage.
"Take this one too Gaia, make sure it’s set up well." Gaia took the manual from Kent with a smile.
This was something she wanted, considering having the chance to be useful to her master was something he wouldn’t pass up on.
She now had three assignments that she would be working on in the coming days.
Akira was already working on her own things, which she planned to give to her master to distribute to his ladies.
That was her way of being useful, so she was doing everything she could to remain valuable.
"Then I will be leaving now," Gaia said before vanishing back to the Tower, where she would get down to business immediately.
Kent then went ahead and checked the second quest in that chain.
It was the next step he had to take, just as he had done with Saintess Val.
The rewards so far were good, so he planned to take the next logical step soon.
⟪Second Quest: Rehabilitating a Saintess⟫
⟪Quest Difficulty: Depends⟫
→ You won the duel, so you also won the bet.
Now, the Saintess is your servant.
→ However, do you just want her to be your Servant in name or in all aspects?
→ If your answer is yes, then ask her the magic question.
→ If she declines to be your servant, the quest will void, and all rewards will be given to you regardless.
→ But if her answer is yes, then the quest to Rehabilitate the Saintess will continue.
⟪Rewards: ⟫
→ 1,000,000 Tower points
→ Arcane Array path
→ Heavenly Red Dragon Rune Blade
The second quest was also meant to give Alina what she had always wanted.
Before the unfortunate incident with the heir of the Miller Noble Family, she wanted only one thing, and that was to become an Array master and be able to draw formations.
It was her passion, and her mom, who worked tooth and nail so she could have the chance, was killed, traumatizing her for 20 good years.
Now, she had her revenge, thanks to Kent, and soon, her man would set her up for the path that would take her to the top.
Kent actually wanted to make sure she had everything.
The lady had been through a lot, so he planned on making her very happy.
Though he loved having sex with her, he wasn’t about to use just that to make her happy.
No, the plan was to ensure she had everything and that she was surrounded by love.
"The Saintess better make the right decision, considering this is the only path to getting some of the best rewards," Kent smiled.
He now had a path for Selene, Ingrid, Neomi, Lilian, and Alina.
Unity was taking things slow, which Kent respected about her.
Of course, he would soon learn why Unity was special and what he would have to go through to make her happy as well.
Then there was Elsa, who had awakened her True Name, so he wasn’t really worried about her progress.
But still, he could already see himself not only surrounded by beauties but also by some of the most powerful women in the universe.
He wanted that.
He craved that, so he would work for it while he grew steadily, with the ultimate side quest being killing the God of Alchemy.
He stood up and stretched.
"I better go see how the aftermath of her defeat is affecting the Sect." Kent appeared inside Saintess Neomi’s room and quickly went to freshen up, putting on a new set of clothes before leaving.
He was headed straight to the Sword Gate, where the Gate Master was currently meeting with some of the elders from the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Kent’s Verdict
paragraphs: About an hour ago, three elders, on the same level as the gate master, arrived at the Sword Gate with frowns on their faces.
They came immediately after news reached them of the duel between Saintess Val and Kent and the outcome they never expected.
The shocking news wasn’t something they could ignore.
After all, they were the ones who told the saintess to come and cause trouble for Kent and his master, so they came to do damage control using arrogance and their superiority.
They think just because they are from the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect, they are supreme. But they are forgetting they are no longer in their domain.
Right now, they are inside a hall in Gate Master Mara’s residence, looking toward the saintess, who was seated beside the gate master.
Obviously, Gate Master Mara wasn’t about to let her leave her side, fearing the elders would kidnap her and run away with her.
Until Kent returns and decides, the saintess can only remain captive while they argue over what to do next.
The back-and-forth had been going on for close to an hour now, yet they couldn’t seem to arrive at a compromise.

"Gate Master Mara, you should know that the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect is not one to take things lying down. You have something that belongs to us, and we want it back. Now, do you want to keep doing this and offend us?"
Elder Cecil, the same lady elder who planned the perfect way to snuff out Kent when he started to rise, said, looking rather angry:
"I don’t know where this anger is coming from, Elder Cecil, but I don’t see where we are at fault here.
Your Saintess challenged my disciple to a duel, and according to the bet, if she lost, she would become a servant to my disciple for 100 years.
Now, I don’t know about your Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect, but my Divine Palace Sect has dignity, and as such, we don’t resort to underhanded means to get what we want," Gate Master Mara said.
"What is that supposed to mean, Gate Master Mara?" Elder Cecil asked. The tone the Gate Master spoke in didn’t sit right with her.
And the last sentence clearly struck a nerve, so she wanted to know just what he was getting at.
"Oh, you don’t think I wouldn’t recognize a scheme when I see one," Gate Master Mara sneered.
"I saw your scheme from a mile away. Do you think all this would have escaped me? I knew the moment she appeared, she was after the new rising star in my sect.

So the bet about him becoming her disciple and joining your sect was all bullshit. You schemers were only using her to get Kent, and when she did, you would try to suppress him and see if he could be controlled.
Obviously, he would have been killed if he wasn’t the obedient kind. But your scheme backfired, and the one now getting trapped is your weapon, who couldn’t cut my disciple.
"So don’t worry, until Kent makes a decision, your disciple, who was used by you, will remain in my sect and under my protection."
Obviously, Saintess Val didn’t know all this. She just knew having Kent as her disciple would piss off Saintess Selene, her rival.
So, hearing she was just a weapon being used made her frown.
This made the Gate Master smile inwardly, looking at the seething elders who could tell the scheming lady in front of them was doing everything for one purpose.
By disclosing this, she was making Val realize her value to the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect.
In a way, she was ensuring the Saintess knew she meant nothing to the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect, and from the look on her face, it was clear she was not happy at the moment.
"Gate Master Mara, you better tread carefully. The Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect is not one you can afford to offend."
"I know, which is why I am not offending anyone. But unless you want to give your sect a bad name by coming against my sect just because we won a bet against you, then go ahead. Do your worst."
She wasn’t worried about them. Though if they clashed, her side would sustain the most damage, the warrior in her wasn’t about to bend the knee in front of the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect.
The bickering continued for an hour until suddenly, a purple-haired youngster made his way to the hall, wearing a small smile on his face.
"Let me guess, you old geezers are here to take the Saintess away, right?" Kent asked, looking at the angry faces glaring back at him with killing intent.
"You are smart for your age, so be sure to make the right decision and let this slide before it escalates to a point you wouldn’t want to cross," Elder Cecil said.𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
"Oh, so you’re threatening me. I guess that concludes it, then." Kent took a seat beside the Gate Master. He was like someone who had finally returned to his domain.
Saintess Val, on the other hand, was looking at him with a mix of emotions.
"Hand over the Saintess back to the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect, and all animosity will be forgiven," Elder Cecil said again, but Kent just scoffed.
"First of all, forget about your threats and the idea that I will accept any proposal from you. The Saintess lost in a fair duel, and as such, she is now my servant.

Now, while I would love to not offend your sect, I also cannot hand the Saintess back to you. So you better go back and let your sect know that for the next 100 years, Saintess Val will be my servant.
Of course, I wouldn’t mistreat her in any way. I am not a monster. However, I doubt after 100 years, she would want to come back to you again.
In fact, I doubt she will want to go back with you now, considering becoming my servant will be much more beneficial to her than spending a thousand years in your sect.
So be a lamb and go back. The Saintess is staying with me now. And let me tell you, the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect would do well not to offend me."

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Testing His Servant
paragraphs: Among everything the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect elders wanted to hear, they never expected a mere brat to end his sentence with those arrogant words.
’do well not to offend me.’
Those words were the most unbelievable words that none of them expected from someone like Kent. It was like he was threatening them and for some reason, they took those words to heart.
It was also the reason why they just couldn’t believe they were being threatened.
As for the Saintess, she was just looking at Kent with an expression filled with shock.
It was like hearing such a plain threat was something she never saw coming. Kent just threatened an entire sect, and the feeling behind it was real.
’Who is this young man’ She wondered.
Gate Master Mara, however, was shocked when she heard Kent’s threat, so she said nothing, mainly because she couldn’t think of anything to say.
"Are you threatening the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect?" Elder Cecil asked.
"Take it however you want to, but know this: I may not appear like it, but when it comes to causing trouble, I am an expert. Now, ask yourself, do you want to offend someone like me?
Also, before you think it, know that your chances of killing me are next to none.
You don’t have what it takes to kill me so better be a lamb and go back. Tell them they will be one saintess short for the next 100 years...perhaps forever."
Kent turned to the Saintess.
"I know this is sudden, but can you tell the Elders your decision?" Kent said.
He wasn’t about to let her go, though. But he also knew the Gate Master had already damaged the relationship between her and her sect.
"Do you want to become my servant?" Kent asked.
"I am willing," she replied almost immediately, making the three Elders look at her with frowns and anger. From the look of things, they had to leave before the situation escalated.
"You will hear from us, brat," they said before leaving.
The negotiation was now void.
Next, they would do what they do best and try to mess with the dragon. Now, when that happens, the universe will step in, and you all know what follows next.
But now that the Elders were gone, Kent sighed and looked at the Saintess again.
"Are you sure you want to become my servant?" he asked. Though he wanted her answer to be yes, now that he had it, he wanted to understand why she made that decision.
"I just want to be away from the sect for a while. Being your servant wasn’t something I wanted, but it was enough to stay away for a while, I guess," she replied, making Kent nod.
"So, you are now my servant, meaning you have to listen to my commands. Are you willing?" he asked again.
"I will listen to you, but don’t do anything that crosses my bottom line," she said, trying to act tough. But in truth, she was just someone who needed to do a lot of thinking.
’I will test her first before officially making her my servant. Who knows what she would do when she gets the chance to run?’ Kent still didn’t trust her, just as she also didn’t trust him.
But that was about to change.
"Since I am your master now, why don’t you go and apologize to the Elders you insulted a couple of days ago?" Kent said, making the Saintess frown.
"Are you serious?" she asked, clearly not expecting to be asked to apologize.
She knew what she did wasn’t the best reflection of her character, but she had to get the Saintess and her disciple out somehow. And now, she was being asked to apologize.
"You offended them, and since you will be living here from now on, it’s only right to apologize and get in their good graces," Kent said, watching her closely to see what she would do.
Unexpectedly, the Saintess nodded and stood up. "I will do as you say. It’s just an apology anyway," she said, walking out.
’Gaia, follow and evaluate her. If she meets the standards, let me know so I can add her to the Servant Tower,’ Kent ordered, and Gaia was more than happy to comply.
After she left, only the Saintess and Kent remained in the hall.
"You do know they won’t take this lying down," she said, but Kent just shrugged.
"They can do whatever they want. It’s not like I have time for them anyway," he said. He wasn’t about to cry over something he didn’t place any value on.
He knew that while he was inside the sect, they wouldn’t do anything drastic. But even if he went out, who was to say they would have much luck?
Unless, of course, they sent someone on the level of a Root Transcendent. But he wasn’t worried—at least not yet.

"If you say so. Just know that while you are inside the sect, I can protect you, but the moment you go out, I won’t be able to do much. I am not your personal bodyguard, so don’t expect me to follow you around," the Gate Master said.

"You wouldn’t have to worry about that, Gate Master. There are things I must handle on my own, and this is one of them. They asked for it, so as an obedient young man, I had to respond," Kent said with a smile.
"Tsk, obedient my foot. Do you know the amount of trouble you alone have brought to this sect? If anything, I should be joining them in torturing you," the Gate Master retorted.
"Yet here you are, protecting me," Kent smiled. "Do you know what I think?"
"What?"
"I think you like me to the extent that you wouldn’t want me getting hurt," Kent laughed.
"Don’t flatter yourself, brat," the Gate Master scoffed.
Kent just smiled and chose to get down to business first. It’s always better to handle business before engaging in pleasures.
"Gate Master, I am looking for someone, and according to the information I have, you are the only one who can help me. My master recommended you, if you must know," Kent said.
"Who are you looking for?" she asked.
"Her name is Nara..." Kent said, and her expression changed instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Her Sister
paragraphs: It was a simple question but the expression that appeared on the gate master’s face said a different story.
Kent wasn’t expecting that.
"What did you just say?" the Gate Master asked, looking closely at Kent. It appeared as though her eyes were scanning every inch of his face, observing even the slightest muscle movement.
"I said I am looking for someone called Nara, and my master said I should talk to you," Kent repeated. The Gate Master’s body shuddered.
Her energy threatened to leak out, but because she had more self-control than one might think, she held steadfast and didn’t make any foolish decisions.
It wasn’t like she would kill him, but she also never expected to hear such a name coming from Kent. That name shouldn’t come from someone like him.
"Who is she to you?" Instead of answering, she asked. She wanted to know first why someone like Kent would be looking for Nara.

"Would you believe me if I said she is someone very important to me?" Kent replied, also noticing that something wasn’t right. The expression and behaviour of the Gate Master hinted at something much deeper.
"Are you joking with me, brat?" she spoke, and this time, she couldn’t hold back her presence. It was just a small leakage, but it was enough to overwhelm Kent.
However, she quickly recovered and reined in her energy.
’Hoo, Root Transcendents are no joke.’ Kent was overwhelmed for a second there, but he wasn’t afraid.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
He was actually very taken aback by how powerful the presence he felt from the Gate Master was, matching nothing like when she had stopped him at the gate weeks ago.
’She is scary, but I like scary,’ he smiled inwardly.
"I am not joking, Gate Master. I know, to some extent, that Nara was once a disciple in this sect. I was told she is a genius. Now, my master said she died years ago, but that is false.
I have reasons to believe she is still alive—well, barely, but she is still alive—and I want to find and rescue her before it’s too late. So, if you know something, please tell me."
Kent said what had to be said.
This was what the quest required of him, and he did that. Now, all he had to do was wait for the Gate Master to tell him something about this mysterious Nara.
However, the Gate Master he was expecting an answer from had blanked out.
Her mind went blank upon hearing what Kent said, so he was barely staring at someone who was shocked to the extent that, before he could snap her out of her daze, she passed out.
Yes, the Gate Master passed out, and if Kent had not been a few steps away, she would have fallen to the floor.
"Dramatic much," Kent said before laying her down in the chair and beginning to wait for her to wake up.

The universe would help him locate her, but he had to go through some processes first. Obviously, he wasn’t about to tell her the truth.

"Big sister is still alive... she-she is still alive." Kent could only watch as the strongest lady he had ever met began to cry in front of him, making him wonder just what he had done to deserve such a sight.
"Take it easy, Gate Master. Though I would pay to watch you cry, we must first handle the matter at hand," Kent said, making the teary-eyed Gate Master look at him with mixed emotions.
After a few minutes, she calmed down. The sudden emotions that occurred were ones she had bottled up for decades.
"Good, now, care to tell me who this big sister is?" Kent asked, and the Gate Master sang like a bird.

She wanted to walk the path of the sword, so she joined the Divine Palace Sect. For years, she rose through the ranks, won duels and competitions, and gained the recognition of millions.
However, just when she reached her prime and was about to rise to a level that would have, by now, set her at the pinnacle of this world, she mysteriously died on a mission.

So, she chose to investigate.
Since nobody knew who she was, she managed to blend in, and for years, she had been chasing one lead to the next.
She knew her sister didn’t die like the reports were saying. She knew this because whenever her sister was going on missions, she would come to see her first.
But the mission they were saying she died on, she never came to her. So she knew something was wrong and for years, she left her passion as a dancer behind and started looking for answers.
Until today when the most troublemaker she had ever met dropped such shocking news on her lap. Obviously, this was a shocker.

"My name is Kent Madson, the most trustworthy Swordsman slash Alchemist you will ever meet," Kent said, flashing all his 32 peerless white teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 277: The Suspicion {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: Sometimes, you just have to lighten the mood to create some space of calm, regardless of the chaos one is in.
Kent chose to break the tension and let the Gate Master recover her emotions first before logical thinking came into play.
’But the fact that she chose to be a dancer really is something,’ Kent said inwardly, subtly picturing the body of the Gate Master dancing and shaking her bum.
’On the other hand, I could pay a fortune to watch her dance,’ Kent smiled.
But he had to give it to the Gate Master. For someone who chose to be a dancer to go from dancing to taking up the sword and becoming a sword sage, it could only take a genius.
Some are naturally born to wield the sword. An example of such people is Jest, Kent’s past self. He was born to wield the sword, so when he picked it up, it was like he was in his element.
Then, from how she described her sister, Kent could tell she was also a natural-born swordsman. So, for her to go from a dancer to a swordsman could mean she was hardworking and equally talented.
If only he knew she was someone known as the sword dancer, for when she fought, it was like she was dancing. A mesmerizing sight.
’She is a genius, no doubt. But I wonder if she will drop the sword when her sister is saved,’ Kent said to himself and sighed.
The Gate Master took close to an hour to return to her normal self before they resumed their conversation.
"You said you have suspicions. Would you care to share?" Kent asked.

"Before you arrived in the sect, I suspected the sect master was behind this. But after a recent action he took, I don’t suspect him anymore—I know he is the one," the Gate Master said, making Kent raise an eyebrow.
"The sect master? How does my presence have anything to do with this?" Kent asked.
"I am sure whatever happened to big sister will happen to you, too. You said there is an evil presence blocking you from sensing where she is at.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
If that were the case, it would only mean that the sect master is an evil practitioner.
The presence of evil is probably coming from him. So, this means he only goes after a unique set of people.
Big sister was a genius like no other. The disciple of the Spear Gate Master was also the same, and now, you have arrived.
He has already shown signs of wanting to come after you, and that is why we managed to come to this conclusion."
"I see. So you and the Spear Gate Master, who is hiding behind the door, are a team in this," Kent said, smiling as he looked toward a certain door to his left.
A few seconds later, it opened, and the gorgeous Gate Master walked forward, smiling.
"Your senses are rather sharp," she said, making Kent smile.
"You can never know who wants to cause harm," he replied before turning to Gate Master Mara, who was looking at him with questioning eyes.

"I don’t know if her disciple is alive or dead, but since Nara is alive, then I can presume she is also alive. All the same, we will find out soon anyway." The two Gate Masters, now sitting side by side, nodded.

"Now, I don’t know about you two gorgeous ladies, but I don’t like the sound of having an evil practitioner as a sect master, so let’s talk plans. Who gets to drive their sword through his heart?" Kent asked, making the ladies frown.
"What?" Kent asked again.
"You do know the Sect Master is a Root Ascension stage expert, someone a hundred of us cannot even last ten minutes against.
And if that is not worse, know that he is a mage capable of casting Tier 10 spell circles," Gate Master Mara said with an expression full of concern. Kent, however, just laughed.
"You don’t get my question, ladies. I am not planning on going toe-to-toe with him. Nah, I am not that stupid. I am still young and full of energy to spend on my ladies; I wouldn’t waste that."
Kent smiled, making the ladies look at him weirdly.

"You’ve heard this saying before, haven’t you? ’Even gods can be killed if you have prep time.’ Well, the Sect Master can also be killed if we have prep time, and let me tell you, ladies, we have more than enough prep time, so he will die.
Now, what I want to know is which of the three of us will get to stab him through the heart when he is down."
Kent’s question was like he had figured everything out already. In truth, he wasn’t scared one bit.
How could someone who has a tower, a cosmic weaver, and a soul weaver on his team be scared of a single human? Nah, Kent had more important things to worry about.
The ladies, who heard his way of expressing his questions, looked at him with an expression that Kent could only smile at.
"Just forget about it. For now, I want you ladies to relax and wait for when I have something new. And don’t worry, it won’t take too much time.
The more time I waste, the longer Nara continues to suffer," Kent said as he stood up and began walking out of the room. However, after a couple of steps, he turned back, and with a smile, he asked,
"The massage offer still stands, Gate Master Mara. I wouldn’t charge a dime, so just let me know when I should come." After saying that, he vanished.
The two Gate Masters stared at where he had stood and then at each other, both sighing.
"Just who is this kid?" Gate Master Camilla asked.

They could only wonder in silence, not knowing what to think. Kent is like that person who appears, and instead of getting to know him, you start asking all kinds of questions that cannot be answered.
He is a mystery, and now, the ladies, whom he had brought some hopeful news, started making plans for when he would return.
The first quest was completed, and he was given the second.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Quest Rewards Review {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: When Kent left the Gate Master’s residence, he went straight to his master’s place. Along the way, he met many disciples, each of whom gave him a look of respect.
They were indeed a bit more respectful now, considering the one walking past them had defeated a saintess in a duel.

As soon as he reached the mansion, he pulled up one of the three messages he had received. One was for making the Saintess his servant. Another was for completing the first quest to find the mysterious Nara.
And the last was the new quest about what to do next to find her.
⟪Congratulations on completing the second quest in the ’Rehabilitating the Saintess’ chain quest. Rewards Received ⟫
⟪Rewards: Recieved⟫
→ 1,000,000 Tower points
→ Arcane Array Path
→ Heavenly Red Dragon Rune Blade
"A path for an array master, huh?" Kent picked up the manual with the golden cover.
It’s a path, just like the sword and spear paths. This path will take Alina from the foundation-building stage to the peak if she has the talent and time for it.
Obviously, she is going to be very happy to have the chance to chase her dreams finally. It would make her very happy indeed.
He then took out the next item.
⟪Heavenly Red Dragon Rune Blade⟫
⟪Grade: Mythic⟫
→ A rune knife forged from the remains of a Red Dragon.
→ All runes carved using this knife will have a 40% strength boost and an aura of a red dragon.
"I don’t know anything about arrays and runes, so I will leave everything to Akira and Alina. Since she is a weaver, it’s only normal for the two to become friends."
After putting away the knife, Kent called out to Gaia and commissioned another path, which the cosmic loli accepted with a beaming smile.
In fact, when Gaia appeared, she had a pencil strapped behind her ear, showing she was working on the architecture for the three jobs he had given her.
Kent only smiled and added another to it. The more busy she was, the less time she would spend thinking about her sister. Well, Kent already has plans to rescue her.
After she left, he dug into the next quest.
⟪Congratulations on completing the first quest in the ’Clash With Evil’ sect quest. Rewards Received ⟫
⟪Rewards: Recieved⟫
→ Battle Space Domain x2
→ The Lost Undead Schematic (Creator Necromancer) x2
→ 1,000,000 Tower Points x2
This one was a sect quest. It was a mini-chain quest containing only three quests. He had already completed one, and since it was his first, all rewards were multiplied.
He received 2 million Tower points, and the rest were also received in double.
Now, he didn’t know what the two other rewards were yet, but he certainly knew receiving double wasn’t something he would argue about. He received them because he worked for them.
He retrieved the first item, and a cylindrical-shaped artefact appeared. It had no edges, and runic markings could be seen all around it.
Kent quickly appraised it, and the results were shocking.
⟪Name: Battle Space Domain⟫
⟪Grade: Divine⟫𝑓𝑟𝑒𝘦𝓌𝑒𝑏𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝘭.𝒸𝘰𝑚
→ A specialized indestructible domain where you have the freedom to battle anyone you want simply by activating it within a 300-meter range of the person or beast.
→ The space is indestructible, perfect for chaotic battles that could easily destroy landscapes and terrains.
→ You have the authority to send whoever you want inside and also the authority to bring out those you wish.
"Damn, this is a good item," Kent grinned, already picturing how best he would use it.
"A battle so dangerous that I would have to send my opponent inside a pocket dimension just to save the space. I wonder when I will fall into a battle of that magnitude."
Kent sighed, but he knew that battle was just around the corner. He took the second disc, which looked and had the same description and use as the first one.
"I will give this one to the girls. Who knows when they might want to challenge each other and wouldn’t want to do it inside the tower," Kent smiled.
"Wait, does this mean when I use this inside the tower, the time difference will have an effect on it?" Kent asked, and Gaia responded.
"Awesome. Then this will really help them," Kent put away the discs and retrieved the next item.
⟪The Lost Undead Schematic (Creator Necromancer)⟫
→ A schematic of a one-of-a-kind undead that hasn’t been seen before.
→ You also have the authority to change the schematic and add your preferences.
→ When you are done, you can use it to create the undead, and the results will be exactly as you wanted.
"Wait a minute. Gaia, care to throw some insight into this?" Kent said, and Gaia was happy to help.
[Basically, the universe has created a one-of-a-kind undead that, from the look of things, is some kind of alien. This undead will be the first of its kind if and when created.
However, that isn’t all. Per the description, you can make your own changes to it. These changes can include the design, abilities it must have, its aspects, and whatnot.
The strange part is, all you have to do is write them. However, you will be required to pay more to create it. So, the more changes you make, the more materials you need to create it.]
"Well, I’ll be damned," Kent laughed, reading the descriptions again. The schematic in front of him is just too good to be true.
Even without any modifications, he can tell that what he was holding cannot be underestimated. It’s something he would probably need in the coming months.
"I most certainly need to start using my Necromancy class because this is just too good to just sit inside my tower storage," Kent laughed again before putting away the schematic.
He had two, and from what he now knew, he would have to spend some quality time creating the next best undead he could using his Necromancy class.
He calmed his beating heart down and then chose to look at the next quest he would have to embark on. The moment he adds the Saintess as a servant, the next quest for her too will show.
He is basically living the quest life...Lol.

→ A schematic of a one-of-a-kind undead that hasn’t been seen before.
→ You also have the authority to change the schematic and add your preferences.
→ When you are done, you can use it to create the undead, and the results will be exactly as you wanted.
"Wait a minute.
Gaia, care to throw some insight into this?" Kent said, and Gaia was happy to help.
[Basically, the universe has created a one-of-a-kind undead that, from the look of things, is some kind of alien.
This undead will be the first of its kind if and when created.
However, that isn’t all.
Per the description, you can make your own changes to it.
These changes can include the design, abilities it must have, its aspects, and whatnot.
The strange part is, all you have to do is write them.
However, you will be required to pay more to create it.
So, the more changes you make, the more materials you need to create it.]
"Well, I’ll be damned," Kent laughed, reading the descriptions again.
The schematic in front of him is just too good to be true.
Even without any modifications, he can tell that what he was holding cannot be underestimated.
It’s something he would probably need in the coming months.
"I most certainly need to start using my Necromancy class because this is just too good to just sit inside my tower storage," Kent laughed again before putting away the schematic.
He had two, and from what he now knew, he would have to spend some quality time creating the next best undead he could using his Necromancy class.
He calmed his beating heart down and then chose to look at the next quest he would have to embark on.
The moment he adds the Saintess as a servant, the next quest for her too will show.
He is basically living the quest life...Lol.

chapters.title: Chapter 279: The Next Step
paragraphs: ⟪Sect Quest: Clash With Evil⟫
⟪Second Quest: Connect with Nara & Give Her Hope⟫
⟪Difficulty: Very Hard⟫
→ The identity of the one named Nara has been discovered. What remains now is to find out how she is doing and where she is.
→ The Universe has awarded you a skill called Astra Soul Projection.
→ This skill will allow you to project your soul out of your body and use a skill called Seek to locate her.
→ The moment she is discovered, you will be able to talk to her and learn more.
→ Your quest is to find her through the Seek ability and determine where she is and how she is faring.
→ The moment you connect with her, her location will be revealed to you in full detail.
⟪Rewards: ⟫
→ 2,000,000 Tower Points
→ Undead Schematic Builder (One-time use only)
→ Dungeon Seeker Card (Ten A Rank Dungeons)
Kent reviewed the quest and sighed. He could tell he had been awarded two skills, yet in a strange way, they did not appear on his status page.
He could sense they were within him, but since they weren’t listed on the page, it meant he didn’t officially possess these skills; they had simply been handed to him for this quest.
What bothers him, though, is whether or not they will become obsolete after the quest.
"So, astral projection, huh? You don’t see that every day," Kent said with a smile, but he wasn’t about to joke. The quicker he found her, the faster he could start making plans to rescue her.
Becoming a certain strange doctor for a moment wouldn’t be a problem.
"Akira," Kent called out, and the Soul Weaver appeared.
[How can I be of help, Master?] Akira asked.
She and Gaia could be in different places at the same time, so he wasn’t shocked when she appeared. A part of her consciousness appeared while another was working inside the tower.
"What can you tell me about astral projection?" Kent asked.
[Astral projection, huh? Well, that basically means you are projecting your soul and consciousness from your body and sending it to places your physical body cannot enter.
It cannot be sensed or noticed easily. Also, all forms of physical attacks are useless against it, so most assassins use this method to spy on their targets before attacking them.]
"Great. Then can I use soul attacks on people when in my astral form?" Kent asked. This sounded like something he should master, and perhaps it might save his life one of these days.
[Yes. If you have soul attacks, you can use them. However, astral projection uses more soul essence, so using soul attacks isn’t ideal when in that form.
You will sustain soul damage if you run out of soul essence before your soul returns to your body.
Sometimes, you may even die just because of that, so it’s always advised not to attack while in your soul form.]
Astral forms are mostly meant to enter places that cannot be accessed using the physical body, mainly because their presence will be nearly nonexistent.
If Kent were to use his astral form, he wouldn’t be easily noticed.
However, even in his astral form, he could be detected if he were careless, so the best thing would be to focus all his energy on keeping his presence hidden.
"Well, I have soul attack immunity, so I’m not worried about being attacked. The problem now is my face being recognized in case I was noticed.
The goal is to keep her captors in the dark for now. So recognising me wouldn’t be ideal."
[Master wouldn’t have to worry about that since the astral form can take on any form you desire. If you want, you can simply turn into a bird and fly to your destination.
You don’t have to appear as a person when in your astral form.]
"Isn’t that convenient?" Kent smiled.
His fear had been quelled, and now he could make his move. However, there was still something else he needed to know.
The astral form is indeed the best way forward; however, what happens when he gets trapped in that form from, let’s say, soul imprisonment?
He is immune to soul attacks, but who is to say his soul cannot be trapped?
Kent knew the chances of the sect master being the culprit were high, so he wanted to be cautious. First, if he was indeed an evil practitioner, the soul arts aren’t something he wouldn’t know.
So then, how will he handle sudden intrusions if he is noticed?
That’s a very important question that cannot be ignored, and Kent knew that. In fact, he wasn’t about to get trapped just like that.
[Under normal circumstances, the master should have to worry about getting trapped. However, you have a connection with Aether Warden.
So, no matter the danger, even if a god traps your soul, she can easily flick her hand and release you.
And since you are connected to her, if you are in any trouble, she will know and come to your aid, so you don’t have to worry.
Plus, your soul cultivation is at Tier 7. This alone makes your soul several times stronger than non-soul cultivators, so you have more soul essence to spend on hiding your soul’s presence.]
"Then I am fortunate, I guess," Kent sighed.
He would be lying if he said he wasn’t nervous. However, he could only go with the flow since it had come down to it.
He was worried about getting trapped.
But knowing Elsa could do this much for him was also reassuring. This made him happy, knowing he was protected regardless of the situation.
’If only I could land one soul attack and take whoever is responsible out, wouldn’t that be great?’ Kent sighed again.
"Thank you, Akira. You are the best."
Akira smiled and vanished back into the tower. Kent had things to do, and one of them involved giving hope to the one currently losing hope after being trapped for over 60 years.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
"I can’t keep her waiting for long, then," Kent said before closing his eyes.
Right now, he had the means to locate the mysterious Nara, give her some hope, and find out more about the monster hiding inside the sect.
The strike team would move in when all discoveries were made, and, if lucky, he might just have a shot at killing an evil practitioner.
Something the Universe will be very pleased with.

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Evil Lair
paragraphs: Kent sat in the lotus posture, eyes closed, as he began using the Astral Projection skill he received from the universe.
The skill took some time, but it activated, and slowly, a version of Kent appeared out of his body and stood in front of him.
’It worked,’ he thought, looking at his real body now sitting like a lifeless shell. Already, he could feel his soul essence being spent. However, he didn’t immediately move.
He tapped into the cheat he received and activated the Seek skill.
Almost immediately, he saw where he had to go.
It was like a Wi-Fi connection asking him to connect. So he left, and when he was outside, he leaped into the air and began flying toward a large mansion somewhere in the Mage Gate.
It took him a couple of minutes, even in his soul form. When he arrived at the mansion, Kent immediately became convinced this was the right place.
For some reason, in his soul form, he could sense the evil qi in the air more pronounced now. Around the mansion, he could clearly sense the evil qi.
It was faint—something not even the gate masters could sense or see. However, he could sense it, and so he began moving toward the trail left by the evil qi.
The Seek skill had brought him to the mansion.
Getting things done was now up to him. He must locate the entrance and move in.𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
So he started moving, and soon, he was inside the house after walking through the door without even opening it.
He was like a ghost in that regard.
"This place is creepy, alright," Kent thought, seeing no one around. Instead, most of the stuff inside the house was covered with white cloth.
It wouldn’t take a genius to know whoever lived in the house didn’t stay there often, so all the things that could be destroyed from the exposure to nature were covered.

"The evil qi leads to the basement through the bathroom." He made his way toward the bathroom, and when he entered, he could tell it hadn’t been used for a while. However, he could also tell someone had been there recently.
But he didn’t linger.
Instead, he entered through a small door that took him straight to the basement, and there, he saw the entrance to hell.
It wasn’t a portal. No, it was more like a dark cave that most definitely didn’t inspire confidence for anyone to enter and explore what it was hiding.
But he cannot back down now.
Kent walked through it regardless, and that was when he came face to face with the evil nature of the lair he had found himself in.
He appeared in a narrow hallway where dimly burning lamps hung on the walls.
"The stories back on Earth did a terrible job portraying evil in the movies," Kent said to himself as he moved through the narrow hallway.
On some parts of the walls, skulls of different types of monsters and humans could be seen. It was as if whoever lived here enjoyed hanging things.
The horror of it all is heartbreaking.

’This person is creepy, for sure,’ he said, but slowly, he made his way out of the hallway. The hallways weren’t that wide, but it was enough to tell whoever was hiding down there that he or she may have visitors.
In fact, even from his basement, there were formations down there that would have alerted him that he was being invaded.
Kent moved through the hallway until he appeared in a new place. He appeared in a new, terrifying setting.
He was face to face with the most chilling sight hanging at the centre of a large hall.
"What the fuck?"
Kent nearly screamed out when he saw the large cauldron hanging and dripping red blood.
It had a tube connected to it, and after tracing some of the tubes, they led to large cages housing spirit beasts.
The horrifying part was that some of these beasts were still alive, but for the dead, it should have been a mercy at this point.
"This person deserves all the torture in this world," Kent said, clenching his fist. The horror surrounding him wasn’t something he was sure people could survive.
"And she had been down here for decades? Just how strong is her will to live?" Kent was impressed, yet he could tell this wasn’t as simple as it appeared.
"I must find her soon," he said before turning into a bat, considering he had seen a few on his way into the lair. It was the perfect camouflage.
He began flying toward the tubes, tracing them to their sources. He wasn’t holding back his speed, so even as a small bat, he was moving several times faster.
After 20 minutes, he finally narrowed down the search and managed to figure out her location. He moved quickly, and soon, he came face to face with two cages housing two ladies.
One was already as pale as she could be, but he could tell she wasn’t dying anytime soon, while the other was graceful and sitting with her eyes closed.
"If I’m not mistaken, the pale one is the disciple of the Spear gate Master—the blonde disciple she was so proud of—and the green-haired beauty is the big sister of the Sword Gate Master."
Kent watched the two ladies in the cage and sighed in his bat form. He seemed to do a lot of sighing, regardless of his situation.
Well, the situation he was in now most definitely required him to sigh a few times. The sight before him was just too heartbreaking.
"They need to be rescued soon; otherwise, from the look of things, they might just give up," Kent said to himself, moving closer to the cage of the green-haired beauty.
Looking at the two, he could tell she was the ideal person to talk to, considering she was the main reason he was there.
After moving a couple of meters closer to the cage, he stopped and thought of the best way to reach her. After a few seconds of thinking, he knew what had to be done.
It wasn’t like the universe would bring him this far without a way to get things done.
Nara, who was sitting quietly and meditating, sensed a disturbance in her surroundings, so she snapped her eyes open. She looked around but could only see a bat hanging on the cave walls.
She closed her eyes again. However, a voice entered her mind before she could get back to her meditation.
[Don’t be alarmed. I am here to rescue you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Conversation with Nara
paragraphs: 65 years.
That is how long Nara had waited to hear those magic words: "I am here to rescue you." Those words struck like a hammer hitting a nail.
It was the phrase anyone in her situation would want to hear.
However, never in her wildest dreams did she think she would hear those words from a bat.
Her eyes snapped open, and for a moment, she expected a human to be standing before her. But all she saw was nothing.
[Don’t make it obvious. Just think of what you want to say, and I will hear everything,] Kent said, causing the lady, who was now looking around frantically, to stop.
She then looked back at the bat.
[Is that you?] she asked, and for a moment, she nearly gave up hope. Talking to a bat should be the last thing someone in her situation should be doing.
One could even say she had finally lost her mind. Kent could see it in her eyes. She was losing it, so he did the only logical thing and brought her back to reality.
[Your baby sister Mara sent me.]
Those were the magic words meant to bring her hope. In fact, the moment she heard the name Mara, she became lively, almost standing up.
[Lady, please, we wouldn’t want your captor to know something is wrong. So just sit there and let’s talk.] Kent was being cautious.
Of course, the lady obeyed him and remained sitting.
[Is Mara really the one who sent you? How is she? Where is she now? Please tell me she has become the greatest dancer the world has ever seen.]
The lady became so happy that if she were to die, she wouldn’t complain. Hearing about what she had been holding on to for all these years, her life had finally gained some hope and joy.

[Well, Mara is alive and living. But she wasn’t exactly living, considering when you apparently died, she followed in your footsteps and became a swordsman just like you so she could learn what truly happened to you.
However, don’t worry. She is safe and has become someone you will be proud of the moment you are out of here.
In fact, I think you should be happy. She never forgot about you, for she never for one moment believed you died. Your sister really believes in you, lady.]
Kent’s words brought a smile to her lips, but the pain in her eyes said it all. She craved to see her sister.
[So she stopped dancing so she could one day come and rescue me? What a silly girl.]

[She, indeed, is one silly little girl. Be sure to spank her when you are out of this place. I can even help you if you don’t mind,] Kent said. He probably would have been smiling if he were in his human form.
[I will be sure to make that happen,] the lady said, smiling slightly as tears fell down her face. Kent said nothing for a few seconds.
[Tell me, Nara, who was the one that captured you and made everyone believe you died?] Kent asked. He knew it was the sect master, but he wanted confirmation.
For all he knew, the sect master was long dead, and someone else was portraying him. So, he needed confirmation first.
Most captors tend to reveal their true colours to their captives, so she was the best person to answer this question.
[It’s the sect master. He was the one who captured me years ago and turned me into his blood bank,] she said, clenching her fist.
[Gate Master Mara was right. Looks like that bastard is the evil practitioner all along,] Kent said.
[Wait, Mara is the gate master?] The lady, however, was focused on something else. Hearing Kent call her sister "gate master" made her raise an eyebrow.
[Like I said, she has become someone you will be proud of. Because of you, she trained and kept training every single day. Right now, she is a sword sage—and a powerful one at that.]
[I knew it. I knew she was talented, but she just hated violence, so she chose to become a dancer. If only I had seen this day coming, I would have joined her and lived a more peaceful life.]
She doesn’t need a genius to tell her that the innocent Mara she knew wasn’t the same innocent girl. Now, Gate Master Mara is as ruthless as they come.
That is what happens when something important to such an innocent person is taken from them. They become the most ruthless people.
[Don’t worry; when you are rescued, she will have her peace back and more. Now, let’s talk about the sect master. Can you tell me everything you know? Anything at all is okay,] Kent asked.
[He is an evil practitioner, alright. However, he is also a mage who, for some reason, has the ability to create abominations.
The last time I saw one of these abominations was 20 years ago, but even back then, when the sect master was just a Peak Root Transcendent, the abomination was a Peak Root Great Sage.
So it can only be assumed that now that he has reached Root Ascension—and from his aura a couple of weeks ago, he was already past level 5—his minions wouldn’t be far behind either.

However, over the past years, I have been analyzing loads of what I managed to gather, and from it all, I can tell that if the cauldron filled with blood were destroyed, something bad would happen to him.
Also, if all the beasts in the cages were killed, the same would happen to him.]
Nara said quite a lot, and from all she said, Kent could tell the lady wasn’t someone simple. Despite the depressing situation she was in, she never lost hope.
She had been studying him from her cage, and from the look of it, she had gathered a lot. Someone like that is worth having as a teammate, a friend and perhaps, a lover.
They will never pull you done.
