sentences.text: 65 years.
That is how long Nara had waited to hear those magic words: "I am here to rescue you." Those words struck like a hammer hitting a nail.
It was the phrase anyone in her situation would want to hear.
However, never in her wildest dreams did she think she would hear those words from a bat.
Her eyes snapped open, and for a moment, she expected a human to be standing before her.
But all she saw was nothing.
[Don’t make it obvious.
Just think of what you want to say, and I will hear everything,] Kent said, causing the lady, who was now looking around frantically, to stop.
She then looked back at the bat.
[Is that you?] she asked, and for a moment, she nearly gave up hope.
Talking to a bat should be the last thing someone in her situation should be doing.
One could even say she had finally lost her mind.
Kent could see it in her eyes.
She was losing it, so he did the only logical thing and brought her back to reality.
[Your baby sister Mara sent me.]
Those were the magic words meant to bring her hope.
In fact, the moment she heard the name Mara, she became lively, almost standing up.
[Lady, please, we wouldn’t want your captor to know something is wrong.
So just sit there and let’s talk.] Kent was being cautious.
Of course, the lady obeyed him and remained sitting.
[Is Mara really the one who sent you?
How is she?
Where is she now?
Please tell me she has become the greatest dancer the world has ever seen.]
The lady became so happy that if she were to die, she wouldn’t complain.
Hearing about what she had been holding on to for all these years, her life had finally gained some hope and joy.
[Well, Mara is alive and living.
But she wasn’t exactly living, considering when you apparently died, she followed in your footsteps and became a swordsman just like you so she could learn what truly happened to you.
However, don’t worry.
She is safe and has become someone you will be proud of the moment you are out of here.
In fact, I think you should be happy.
She never forgot about you, for she never for one moment believed you died.
Your sister really believes in you, lady.]
Kent’s words brought a smile to her lips, but the pain in her eyes said it all.
She craved to see her sister.
[So she stopped dancing so she could one day come and rescue me?
What a silly girl.]
[She, indeed, is one silly little girl.
Be sure to spank her when you are out of this place.
I can even help you if you don’t mind,] Kent said.
He probably would have been smiling if he were in his human form.
[I will be sure to make that happen,] the lady said, smiling slightly as tears fell down her face.
Kent said nothing for a few seconds.
[Tell me, Nara, who was the one that captured you and made everyone believe you died?] Kent asked.
He knew it was the sect master, but he wanted confirmation.
For all he knew, the sect master was long dead, and someone else was portraying him.
So, he needed confirmation first.
Most captors tend to reveal their true colours to their captives, so she was the best person to answer this question.

They become the most ruthless people.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Demons...OR {Gift Bonus Chapter}
paragraphs: [I promise you, I will come back and rescue you soon,] Kent said as he flew deeper into the cave, searching for the dangers that awaited him and his allies when they came for the rescue mission.
He had to be thorough if he wanted to have a shot at saving the green-haired beauty and the pitiful disciple of the Spear gate master.
He moved through the underground cave for a while, but nothing else was found besides the cages housing the beasts.
However, he didn’t give up.
He never believed the evil within this evil lair wouldn’t have something spooky up his sleeves. He needed to use his time there wisely, considering his soul essence was running low.
Nara told him that the sect master had minions that he seemed to have created. She had seen them several times and didn’t fail to point that out to him.
He wanted to see what those were. However, it wasn’t proving to be something he would have any luck with, as after moving for close to two hours, he found nothing.
It was like those minions or their masters were hidden from sight. Kent was clearly disappointed.
However, just when he was about to give up, an entrance opened at a dead end as he was just leaving.
From the entrance, a monstrous figure could be seen dragging a beast inside a cage toward the direction of the cauldron.
Kent was stuck to the walls as a bat, so he could see everything.
The figure was humanoid in nature, but all its features were monstrous.
It has six arm-like tendrils that are longer than they should be. The body is coated in some kind of decaying material. The legs are larger than they should be, and the mouth is very large.
The eyes are red and larger than usual. There was no hair on the body.
"Is that a demon?" Kent thought as he watched the demonic figure drag the cage away. It wasn’t exactly what he expected, but it gave him a way to learn about what he came for.
"So the dead ends are just fake walls," Kent thought and moved. All the dead ends he had visited were fake walls that pointed to the same place.
Soon, he was in front of the fake wall. He moved through it and found himself in a large space that he knew for a fact he shouldn’t be in.
It wasn’t meant to be discovered, but here he was, staring at hundreds of cocoons housing spider-like monsters, each colossal in nature.
Then he saw the monstrosities moving about, and he could only sigh as he stuck to the walls.
He saw the demonic-looking figures, like the one he had encountered right before he entered the real lair of the sect master.
But aside from them, there were others. They were spiders in nature, but they had feet that allowed them to stand on their own two legs.
They also have an arm, but on their back are close to eight limbs, each ending in a razor-sharp appendage.
Kent didn’t move any closer, mainly because he sensed a powerful presence sitting inside a small room just a few meters from where he was.
The feeling he was getting from the person wasn’t one he was eager to investigate.
If possible, he wouldn’t leave any suspicion behind, so the sect master wouldn’t have a reason to kill the two ladies before he could launch the rescue mission.
"My soul essence is almost running out. I have to go back and return later," Kent thought as he flew away, making sure he was as quiet as possible.
Luckily for him, he was able to leave without raising any suspicions.
However, before leaving, he went to say another goodbye to the green-haired beauty, who was now feeling hopeful.
Hearing about her sister gave her something to hold on to.
She wanted to pass some of that hope to the dejected disciple of the Spear Gate Master, who had not been faring well these past few days.
Kent told her the odds they would be going up against.
[Is that even possible to overcome?] she asked.
[Nothing is impossible, Nara. Provided the sect master is separated from his minions, we can get this done and done well enough,] Kent said.

[But that’s just separating them. He is still a Root Ascension stage expert. How can he be killed? Only his death will ensure everything is truly over. Someone just 2 stages below the peak of this world can’t easily be killed. I know that for sure,] she replied, showing she didn’t act without a solid plan.
She had 60 years plus to make several plans, but at every end, she saw no way of beating the sect master. He is just too powerful in her eyes.
But Kent was different.
[As I told you, sister, everything can be killed, provided you have enough prep time. Now, I know what I’ll be up against.
This means I have to prepare well, which I have all the means to accomplish. So just relax. I will return when I have enough soul strength for one last sweep.
I promise you, within the next three weeks, you will be free from this place. I just need to figure out a few things first," Kent assured her.]
[Take all the time you need. I will ensure she doesn’t lose hope. So we will all wait for you to come rescue us,] she said before Kent flew away.
He saw the danger and knew things wouldn’t be that simple.
This meant he had to make preparations, and that would involve building his relationship with the two gate masters to some extent so he could trust them enough to let them in on some of his secrets.
He would be lying if he said he could take on this rescue mission all by himself. The danger was just too great. But that didn’t mean he would give up.
No, the third quest had appeared, and it would set him on the path of what to do next.
His ladies were there, and Uncle Drew was also there. This meant if he managed to get the gate masters involved, he would be able to get this done, even in the most dangerous way possible.
But he had everything under control for now.
The auction was in four days’ time, but before then, he planned on coming back again to assess the situation and further come up with the right and good plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Dangerous Preparation Quest, Final Quest {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: "Fuck, this feels like doing mushrooms all over again," Kent said as he woke up back in his body. He felt drowsy, and euphoria and vertigo overwhelmed his senses when he woke up.
The feeling of having his body return back to his body is just too euphoric in a way. It’s like doing bad drugs.
"But the good thing is I succeeded, and I now know that the two ladies are alive and can be rescued." He sighed. "The question is how I’m going to go about it."
He couldn’t free them in his soul form, so it meant he had to enter there in his physical form. This meant he would have to fight, and the battle wouldn’t be simple.
"But to think a whole sect leader of such a prestigious sect would be this evil," Kent sighed.
The idea of that being true was just something nobody would believe, yet it was right inside the sect. And from the skulls he saw, many had fallen prey to his evil practices.
"I’m going to enjoy killing him," he muttered before looking at the third and final quest.
⟪Sect Quest: Clash With Evil⟫
⟪Second: Dangerous Preparation⟫
⟪Difficulty: Very Hard⟫
→ The Sect Master is the Evil behind it all. He has 310 minions, of which 300 are at the Root Great Sage stages and 10 are Root Transendents.
→ He also has a life-saving item that can allow him to teleport to a faraway place if he wants.
→ However, you mustn’t allow that to happen.
→ You must gather allies and ensure your strike team is ready within the next 30 days.
→ Use everything you have to destroy the sect master before evil spreads through the entire sect and consumes everyone.
→ Failure to kill the sect master has a 97% chance to come back and hunt you.
⟪Rewards: ⟫
→ 20,000,000 Tower Points
→ True Name Token (Five)
→ Memory Key
"Hmm, this is a crazy lineup for my first major mission," Kent said, reading through the quest. The odds are just too much for someone like him not to complain.
"But I am not alone, and like I said, with enough planning, I can do this." The minions under the sect master alone are enough to handle the entire sect.
But that can be managed, considering he already has four people who can handle Root Transcendents.
Though the two Saintesses aren’t at the Root Transcendent stage yet, they are no ordinary beings, and after letting them rebuild their foundations, they will become even stronger.
Then there is the battle doll, which has mastered hundreds of sword skills. Gaia provided with all the sword skills Kill wanted.
Now, all he needed were resources to upgrade it. Luckily, the auction is coming, and he can buy rare and powerful metal ores.
This will allow him to upgrade the battle doll to an even higher stage.
"If I buy five more dolls and manage to upgrade them, they will become Transcendents, and thanks to all the skills I will provide them, they can take on multiple targets.
This will take care of the ten Root Transcendents. Then, even if I don’t have enough points for more, I can count on my ladies to handle the Root Great Sages." Kent sighed.
"I will make sure the dolls handle the ten Root Transcendents. Then the ladies will handle the Root Great Sages, while I and the two gate masters go after the sect master."
The plan looks weak, but he has to use what he has.
⟪The master can use the Dungeon Seeker Card to access the A-rank Dungeons, and using the Dungeon Master Token, you can claim the dungeons.
This will allow you to summon the final floor bosses, which will be a Root Great Sage at the peak.⟫
"I almost forgot about that," Kent said, taking a rectangular card.
It’s a card that randomly selects ten dungeons from all over the universe, and using it, one can be teleported to the first floor and back.
The only exception is that you cannot walk out of the dungeon, so when you enter, you can only leave using the card.
Right now, in his hands, he has one that has selected 10 random A-rank dungeons, of which the last floor boss is a Peak Root Great Sage.
However, the only reason why this is something he needs is because of his Dungeon Master Token.
Those tokens allow him to claim any dungeon he wants, provided he manages to defeat the last floor boss.
Also, in doing so, he will have the authority to summon the last-floor boss. And he has ten dungeons to select from.
If he manages to claim all dungeons within the next 30 days, he will have 10 Peak Root Great Sages under his command.
He only has two Dungeon Master Tokens now, but he can buy more from the Tower, which, in a way, will be paid for using the points he will earn by clearing every floor of the dungeons.
Basically, he now has the means to farm for subordinates and points.
"This is great. With me having the points to buy more battle dolls, clearing these dungeons will be easy enough," Kent smiled before falling back on the bed.
"I have two Root Transcendents, three Root Great Sages—four if Saintess Val is counted—and three Root Sages.
Uncle Drew is also there, and the Battle Doll is there as well. Soon, I will be gaining another key to unlock a part of my memory, meaning I will also grow much more monstrous.
I’d say this quest is already in the bag.
I will rest for now and tell Nara that she should be ready because she will be free in 30 days. She and that poor disciple have suffered enough; they should have some peace soon enough."
Kent closed his eyes and drifted into sleep. Using his soul actively had taken a toll on his body, so he drifted into sleep and, for two days, didn’t wake up.
It was only when Selene came out of the Tower—because in two days’ time, the auction, which would last for three days this time, would commence—that Kent finally stirred.
All his ladies had become Body cultivators, but they came out to spend some time with Kent before the auction.
Kent woke up, and he first went back to the cave and relayed the information to the green-haired beauty, who was more than happy to hear it.
Later, he went to check up on the two gate masters, who hadn’t been able to sleep for the past few days. They wanted to hear back from the brat who was looking for ways to rescue Nara and Zaila.

All his ladies had become Body cultivators, but they came out to spend some time with Kent before the auction.
Kent woke up, and he first went back to the cave and relayed the information to the green-haired beauty, who was more than happy to hear it.
Later, he went to check up on the two gate masters, who hadn’t been able to sleep for the past few days.
They wanted to hear back from the brat who was looking for ways to rescue Nara and Zaila.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Before The auction
paragraphs: "You ladies look like you need some sleep," Kent said when he arrived at Gate Master Mara’s residence. Gate Master Camilla was there, as always.
After the discovery that the sect master was involved with the disappearance of her precious disciple, she always spends her time with Gate master Mara.
"Kent, you are here," Gate Master Mara said, appearing happy.
"Yeah, I am here. I said I would be back, so here I am," Kent smiled. "Do you ladies miss me?" he asked, but the two ladies just glared at him, demanding answers.
"You ladies are not fun," he sighed and sat down.
"Right now, I have good news and bad news. Which one do you want to hear first?" Kent asked.
"The good, obviously," Gate Master Camilla said, causing Gate Master Mara to nod in support.
"Well, the good news is, the two lovely ladies are still alive.
Well, Nara is still as gorgeous as ever, but your disciple was recently threatened, so she wasn’t doing too well. But she is alive and will soon be more than well.
Again, your sister is amazing. She is like a big sister to her disciple."
Kent spoke, and the two ladies, hearing that their sister and disciple were well, could only shed tears of joy.
"Zaila is alive; she really is alive," Gate Master Camilla broke down in tears, hearing that her most loved disciple was still alive. It was all she had wanted to hear these past couple of days.
"Yes, she is alive, and we will rescue her soon enough."
"Thank you," she said, looking up at Kent with tears on her face as she thanked him. The sincerity in her words said it all. She is both happy and thankful.
"Don’t worry about it. We will rescue them so you can spend the rest of your life with your precious disciple. However, before we can do that, we must first kill an evil man and his minions.

Right now, I count 300-plus minions, but I will take care of them. Our priority now is the sect master, and from the presence I sensed when I was down there, he is not going to be an easy nut to crack.
We have to prepare well," Kent said, making the two ladies calm their emotions and focus on him.
"What should we do? I don’t care how dangerous it is. As long as Big Sister gets to live in the end, I will do anything," Gate Master Mara said.
"We are going to do a lot. But for now, I just need you ladies to be at your peak, and for that to happen, you need to get some resources, which I am sure will be sold at this auction.
So, what do you think? Do you want to be my guest at this year’s annual auction? Bills on me."
On one side of things, taking them to the auction would make them much stronger and closer. After all, the campaign to rescue the two ladies will have Kent revealing more of his secrets.
So, getting to know them better and building that trust will go a long way.
His rule is very simple: From trust, he can then thrust.
So, in a way, Kent had just asked two heavenly, breathtaking beauties on a date where he planned on spending billions as if he were farming spirit stones.
Well, he could just buy bingo cards in the tower to multiply his cash, so in a way, he was indeed farming the stones.
But this was also a way for him to get to know them better and, perhaps, if possible, let them learn more about him.
If, after spending this much money they still don’t open up, then he will exclude them from the teams and measure up to the odds in his own way.
One had to fall for that even if their principles are solid. He is basically asking them to come and spend his money for free. No strings attached.
Well, the strings are faint at the moment, but they are there nonetheless.
The universe hadn’t given him a quest yet, so he could only do it the old-fashioned way. Get to know them and build it from there.
"Are you sure you can accommodate the two of us?" Gate Master Camilla said with a small smile. She wanted to tease her uptight friend, but it seemed she wasn’t in the mood.
"You wouldn’t have to worry about that. Just get dressed, and in two days’ time, I will come to pick you up," Kent said, and the two ladies nodded.
"Now, where is my servant who I asked to go apologize to the elders?" Kent asked, and Gate Master Mara pointed in a certain direction.
He thanked her and started moving toward a certain mountain peak, where he could see sword light flashing through the air.
"Hello, servant of mine, ’tis I, your master. I cometh to have a chat with you," Kent said, watching as the saintess intentionally directed her attacks toward him.
"You do know I can still beat you up, right?" Kent said evading the attacks coming her way. Though her attacks didn’t contain killing intent, they were very annoying.
She still couldn’t believe a mere Grandmaster was able to beat her in a sword duel. Her loss was something she never saw coming.
Though she had lost twice against Saintess Selene, Kent was different.
"Fine, I just came to tell you we will be going to the auction in two days, so be ready. I will come pick you up," Kent said before moving away. The lady was just too annoying.
But that wouldn’t be for long.
Like he told the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect elders, after 100 years, she wouldn’t even think of coming back to them.
The Dragon wouldn’t just let go of his meat just because she had a powerful backing.
After leaving her alone to vent her frustration, Kent went straight to the Spear Gate, where he planned on going to the Tasty Home Pavilion with Ingrid.
This, of course, was just his plan to invite three beauties who would, for some reason, be around that place when he and Ingrid arrived.
Kent wanted to invite Elsa, Lilian, and Unity to dine with them. This way, when he invited them to go to the auction with him, people would definitely flip.
He would monopolize all the beauties in the sect, and when he arrived at the auction, he would surely show the entire kingdom the Dragon doesn’t care about money—for he prints money.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Going To The Auction
paragraphs: The day for the auction finally arrived.
All over the sect, the core and inner disciples who had invitations had already left for Vastport City, where the auction would take place.
Sect elders and gate masters were no different. This was the annual auction where some of the most powerful items—and even soul items—were traded.
The Green Leaf Auction House had the farthest reach when it came to procuring some of the most valuable treasures one could ever hope to obtain.
Across the four kingdoms, powerful and wealthy individuals had already gathered to attend the auction.
Over the next three days, some of the most valuable treasures would be sold, and only those with the deepest pockets would walk away smiling.
But not everyone was going there to buy. Some had their own motives, and one such person was Kent, who was going there to complete a mission.

The first chain quest he received tasked him with targeting the Dark Devil Church and the Hand. The Dark Devil Church had come after Li Hua, and the Hand had nearly killed his master, who was now his wife.
Naturally, he was furious. The quest required him to go after them, and his first target was to assassinate Bright Faywood, the head of the Faywood noble family in the Eldorath Kingdom.
Under normal circumstances, Kent would have travelled there to carry out the assassination. However, he chose a different approach—he wanted to do this in the cleanest way possible.
"Gaia, I will be buying the Six-Eyes Shadow Spider like you recommended," Kent said.
He wasn’t about to do the killing himself; he would employ the expertise of a creature Gaia had recommended when he first awakened the tower.
All he had to do was let the shadow creature enter his shadow, and the rest would take care of itself whenever he desired.
"You know what, make it two. I want one inside the head of the Miller family’s shadow too," Kent instructed, and the cosmic weaver complied.
Though he wasn’t aware that his ladies were already planning to go after that family, it wouldn’t hurt to keep his eyes on them for now.
After making the purchase, he left the Guardian Tower and returned to the real world, where his master was already done and waiting for him.
"You are looking fantastic, Master," Kent said, kissing her.
"I am a saintess. Me appearing at an auction is a big deal, in case you didn’t know," Selene replied, smiling.
"Then I guess I will be basking in the glory of three Saintesses," Kent said, making Selene frown slightly.
"So she is coming, huh?" Selene knew Saintess Val, who treated her as a rival, was now staying in the Gate Master’s residence and had become Kent’s servant.
But obviously, the rivalry between them wasn’t about to make her suddenly become best friends.
"She will come, Selene. She is now my servant, and though I wouldn’t say anything now, I need her in the coming days.
So, try to be friendly with her, please," Kent said, knowing that if the two ladies fought again, his master would wipe the floor with her.
Though he actively gained stat points when they levelled up, Gaia had mentioned that they also received points directly added to their stats whenever he came in them.
So, in a way, the Saintess was monstrous now. She is a level 3 Root Great Sage, but she is several times stronger than the same person in the same stage.
And now, she had also become a body cultivator.
"I will do my best. But if she tries anything funny, I will injure her in multiple places," Selene said before wrapping her arms around her disciple and kissing him.
"We have to go; your sisters are waiting," Kent said, breaking the kiss. Selene pouted but knew he was right.
Two days ago, Kent caused a ruckus in the sect when he invited three beauties to dinner inside the Tasty Home Pavilion.
Unity, Elsa, and Lilian were around that place when Kent and Ingrid arrived. Obviously, the guys nearby were shooting their shots, but nothing seemed to connect for them.
They were frustrated, but they became angry when Kent came and took the three angels with him. When they came out, they were laughing with him.
Then, to make matters worse, he invited them to the auction, which the ladies accepted. This was like a hammer hitting their heads.
The fact that he never considered their feelings and straightaway took the three beauties from them said it all: he doesn’t care about their feelings.
Now, he will be going to the auction with Selene, Neomi, Ingrid, Elsa, Unity, Lilian, Val, Mara, and Camilla. One has to give it to him—he most certainly knows how to anger people.
Appearing at the auction surrounded by these beauties will certainly make him the most hated person there.
And even worse, he has enough money to buy anything he wants.
Uncle Drew, who arrived yesterday, pulled up the most majestic carriage anyone had ever seen. Kent had to give it to him—his talent as a carriage driver was something to be commended.
He planned on making him his cosmic driver. So one of these days, when he is strong enough, he and the Captain of the night riders will cruise through the starry skies exploring planets and realms.
After picking him up, Uncle Drew went to fetch the Saintess and her disciple. Then, Unity, Elsa, and Lilian were next.
After that, he went to pick up the two Gate Masters and his mischievous servant, who was shocked to see so many amazing ladies around her master.
Once everyone was ready, Uncle Drew left the sect and headed toward Vastport City.
The carriage looked small on the outside, but for some reason, it was spacious inside. Despite ten people being in it, more could still enter.
Inside the carriage, Kent could only smile as he watched his master and Val have a stare-down. In fact, it got to the point where he could see their sword qi clashing, so he had to step in.

"Ladies, though, I wouldn’t have a problem watching you battle it out, ripping each other’s clothes off; remember that this is an auction, and we are all going there to buy things and spend time together. So, let’s calm down a bit.
Also, if you fight, I won’t buy anything for you during the auction."
"Tsk, you make it sound like you’re rich..." Saintess Val scoffed, making Kent smile.
An hour later, they arrived in Vastport City, where a VIP reception was waiting for them.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Bitch Please
paragraphs: Kent and his ladies were led to VIP Room 13, where they would share neighbours with the entourage from the Faywood Noble family and the Miller family.
A lot had happened, and now everyone wanted to get close to Kent.
Of course, the arrangement was made by Alina, who didn’t bat an eye to organize this. She had her man’s interests at heart.
So despite knowing he will be committing murder with this arrangement, she didn’t bat an eye arranging it.
However, the Zephyr Merchant family, who were in charge of the auction, had already started moving to get into his good graces.
Someone like Kent is destined to explore many ancient ruins. This means he will be bringing out many valuables. So, to call dibs on those, they wanted to earn his favour.
They offered him the best services by assigning maids who would take care of everything during the three days they would spend at the auction.
They planned to approach him later.
If only they knew they were already in Kent’s good graces.
Alina had already told him how they took her in and provided everything she needed. They became her second family and ensured she grew up well.
This alone was enough for Kent to hold them in high regard. They were the benefactors of his wife, so he would repay them well.

"If I didn’t know better, I’d say the Silver Leaf Auction House is showing favoritism. How is it that we get our own dedicated maids while the others don’t?" Saintess Val, who was sipping a glass of wine, asked.
They are settled in VIP Room 13.

It’s one of the many VIP rooms in the large auction house. Of course, she wasn’t complaining about the drinks, but it was indeed true—they were getting the favourite child treatment, unlike the other nobles.
"That’s because I am handsome, and everyone treats handsome people well," Kent replied, causing his wives and even the two gate masters to smile.
Saintess Val looked at him and smirked. Kent doesn’t know it yet, but the lady he had taken in as his servant is someone who likes to steal from people.
She doesn’t have much money on her, but since Kent was offering, she wouldn’t be shy. In fact, Li Hua would like her in that aspect.
But Kent doesn’t care even if she were to buy the entire auction. He had trillions in spirit stones—who is to say he will run out of cash?
"Like I said, ladies, buy what you want using my money. You will pay back one way or the other," Kent said, flashing an evil smirk.
His wives understood the reference, but the two gate masters and the rude saintess were oblivious. If only they knew what he meant, perhaps they wouldn’t have accepted even a penny from him.
More and more people started appearing, each taken to their rooms to relax and wait for the first day of the auction to begin.
Kent saw the Faywoods enter their room a couple of minutes ago. He sized them up and could tell the one he had to kill was just a Level 5 Root Great Sage.
He came with three wives and five others. Two were Root Transcendents, and from their aura, he could tell they were not to be underestimated.
’I must tread carefully and ensure the bug is planted well,’ Kent said to himself. If they were mere Root Great Sages, he wouldn’t have to worry too much. But now, he had to be careful.
He was within the range to put the shadow spider in the shadow of Bright Faywood, but he knew that could easily be noticed.
So he kept waiting while keeping an eye on things. Suddenly, a maid moved past Room 13 and entered Room 14.
A while later, she came out again with a frown. Obviously, they had wanted something else, and from the frown on her face, they hadn’t asked nicely.
He smirked. "Ladies, I will be back in a few minutes," Kent said before walking out of the room. He went straight toward where the maid went.
He would put the spider in her shadow, and then, when she returned to Room 14, he would command it to enter Bright’s shadow. This would even allow him to hear what they said during the auction.
In fact, on the way, he entertained the idea of bugging everyone, considering some of the most influential people were now gathered in one place.
However, considering he needed the tower points for the upcoming rescue mission, that would be a waste.
Kent walked down the hallway but was forced to stop when a certain familiar face blocked his path.
"Just great," Kent muttered.
"What do you want?" he asked. Annabelle, the disciple of the Wicked Poison Witch who came to get revenge a couple of weeks ago at the sect, now stood in his path, her expression furious.
"Remove the seal you placed on my soul," she demanded, but Kent simply shrugged.
The seal linked her soul to his—if something happened to him, the same would happen to her. This was his way of keeping the Wicked Poison Witch away from his business for a few weeks.
He had real things to worry about and if possible, he wouldn’t want to have a Pill Saint running after him.
This was also why kent wanted to back then take care of her ones and for all.
He had made a move to anger Annabelle’s Master and perhaps provoke her into attacking someone he cared about.
This would have given him a reason to kill her and remove a future obstacle. However, in the end, he only had to use her poisoned body to deter her.𝕗𝗿𝕖𝐞𝐰𝗲𝕓𝐧𝕠𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝐨𝚖
Now, the Pill Saint had locked herself in her room, not even allowing her disciple to get close.
It was apparent that her master was not happy with the turn of events after she came seeking revenge for her disciple.
"If you don’t do it, I will make sure your life becomes miserable," Annabelle said arrogantly.
"Bitch, please.

You don’t have anything under your skirt, and in case you’re not aware, I’m playing in leagues far above your own. So go look for your own playmates," Kent retorted, not even bothering to look at her as he walked away.
His mission was far more important than bickering with a spoiled bitch who couldn’t take a loss.

How is it that we get our own dedicated maids while the others don’t?" Saintess Val, who was sipping a glass of wine, asked.
They are settled in VIP Room 13.
It’s one of the many VIP rooms in the large auction house.
Of course, she wasn’t complaining about the drinks, but it was indeed true—they were getting the favourite child treatment, unlike the other nobles.
"That’s because I am handsome, and everyone treats handsome people well," Kent replied, causing his wives and even the two gate masters to smile.
Saintess Val looked at him and smirked.
Kent doesn’t know it yet, but the lady he had taken in as his servant is someone who likes to steal from people.
She doesn’t have much money on her, but since Kent was offering, she wouldn’t be shy.
In fact, Li Hua would like her in that aspect.
But Kent doesn’t care even if she were to buy the entire auction.
He had trillions in spirit stones—who is to say he will run out of cash?
"Like I said, ladies, buy what you want using my money.
You will pay back one way or the other," Kent said, flashing an evil smirk.
His wives understood the reference, but the two gate masters and the rude saintess were oblivious.
If only they knew what he meant, perhaps they wouldn’t have accepted even a penny from him.
More and more people started appearing, each taken to their rooms to relax and wait for the first day of the auction to begin.
Kent saw the Faywoods enter their room a couple of minutes ago.
He sized them up and could tell the one he had to kill was just a Level 5 Root Great Sage.
He came with three wives and five others.
Two were Root Transcendents, and from their aura, he could tell they were not to be underestimated.
’I must tread carefully and ensure the bug is planted well,’ Kent said to himself.
If they were mere Root Great Sages, he wouldn’t have to worry too much.
But now, he had to be careful.
He was within the range to put the shadow spider in the shadow of Bright Faywood, but he knew that could easily be noticed.
So he kept waiting while keeping an eye on things.
Suddenly, a maid moved past Room 13 and entered Room 14.
A while later, she came out again with a frown.
Obviously, they had wanted something else, and from the frown on her face, they hadn’t asked nicely.
He smirked.
"Ladies, I will be back in a few minutes," Kent said before walking out of the room.
He went straight toward where the maid went.
He would put the spider in her shadow, and then, when she returned to Room 14, he would command it to enter Bright’s shadow.
This would even allow him to hear what they said during the auction.
In fact, on the way, he entertained the idea of bugging everyone, considering some of the most influential people were now gathered in one place.
However, considering he needed the tower points for the upcoming rescue mission, that would be a waste.
Kent walked down the hallway but was forced to stop when a certain familiar face blocked his path.
"Just great," Kent muttered.
"What do you want?" he asked.
Annabelle, the disciple of the Wicked Poison Witch who came to get revenge a couple of weeks ago at the sect, now stood in his path, her expression furious.
"Remove the seal you placed on my soul," she demanded, but Kent simply shrugged.
The seal linked her soul to his—if something happened to him, the same would happen to her.
This was his way of keeping the Wicked Poison Witch away from his business for a few weeks.
He had real things to worry about and if possible, he wouldn’t want to have a Pill Saint running after him.
This was also why kent wanted to back then take care of her ones and for all.
He had made a move to anger Annabelle’s Master and perhaps provoke her into attacking someone he cared about.
This would have given him a reason to kill her and remove a future obstacle.
However, in the end, he only had to use her poisoned body to deter her.𝕗𝗿𝕖𝐞𝐰𝗲𝕓𝐧𝕠𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝐨𝚖
Now, the Pill Saint had locked herself in her room, not even allowing her disciple to get close.
It was apparent that her master was not happy with the turn of events after she came seeking revenge for her disciple.
"If you don’t do it, I will make sure your life becomes miserable," Annabelle said arrogantly.
"Bitch, please.
You don’t have anything under your skirt, and in case you’re not aware, I’m playing in leagues far above your own.
So go look for your own playmates," Kent retorted, not even bothering to look at her as he walked away.
His mission was far more important than bickering with a spoiled bitch who couldn’t take a loss.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: Start of the Auction {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: After leaving the Rude Annabell behind to ponder her life choices, Kent quickly found the maid who was sending a bucket of wine to the Faywoods.
He discreetly placed the spider in her shadow without her noticing and returned to VIP room 13.
A short while later, the maid arrived in VIP room 14, where she moved about, placing the wine on the tables beside the seats.
When she passed Bright Bright’s seat, Kent commanded the spider, which slipped into his shadow without anyone noticing. The moment it entered his shadow, he was as good as dead.
All Kent had to do was wait for three days. After the auction, he would kill him and extract his memories, which would help him continue with the Quest.
The ultimate goal was to bring down the entire Dark Devil Church. They are causing too much harm and so for that, they had to go.
But for now, he was at an auction, and it was about to start.
Powerful people had gathered and were ready to bid on items and show off their wealth. Some came with many expectations, and many will be left disappointed after they fail to win any bid.
Kent was seated, surrounded by ladies as they sipped their wine, waiting for the auction to begin. It didn’t take long for the atmosphere to be set.
The auction hall fell silent as the lights dimmed, focusing on the stage.

A tall, elegant woman with sharp features, heavy on the butt and a confident stride walked to the centre. She was Alina, the auctioneere. Her presence commanded attention as she moved toward the main stage.
This was her moment, for she had waited for this for a very long time. She had wanted to host an auction of this magnitude for years.
Finally, it was thanks to Kent that she managed to climb that stage.
The people there couldn’t see it, but Kent could tell she was very happy inside.
Thanks to the support from her sisters and a goddess, she had grown confident over the past few weeks she had spent with them inside the tower.
She stood on the stage, looking beautiful. Kent saw some men gawking over her, but he just smirked. They could look, but they couldn’t touch.
That ass had already been claimed long ago. They could go look elsewhere.
"Welcome, everyone, to this year’s annual auction. I am Alina, your host for this event."
She paused for a few seconds.
"I know you are all eager to bid on items. Don’t worry, we have more than enough for everyone... Well, that is if you have the money." Everyone laughed at her joke.

"This year is packed with some of the most valuable items you will ever set your eyes on. Trust me, you won’t be missing out. Just being here and seeing what we have to offer is enough, even if you can’t win the bid.
So take solace in knowing that after this three-day event, you will be exposed to so much that if you were to die afterwards, you wouldn’t have any regrets.
I am not saying you will die, but you get the idea." The laughter filled the hall again, making Kent smirk at her cheekiness.
She was getting into her groove, and with Unity in her ears, only the heavens would know what she was being told.
But it was good to see sisters supporting each other. Her jokes weren’t that funny, but the one telling them was someone nobody would want to offend.
So, they chose to amuse themselves before the battle began.
"Before we begin, let us go over the rules."

"First, all bids must be made in Spirit Stones. No other currency will be accepted. We also don’t accept treasures in exchange, so it will be best to sell your treasures and use the Spirit Stones instead."
"Second, once an item is sold, the transaction is final. No returns or exchanges."
"Third, bidding must be done in a respectful manner. Any disruptions will result in removal from the event."
"Fourth, the highest bidder wins the item. No exceptions."𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
"Fifth, all items must be collected by the end of the night. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture."
"And finally, this is an auction house. Your status as a family head is left outside. In here, it’s your money that speaks for you, so be mindful of how you throw your name around."
Alina smiled. "Now that we have the rules clear, let the auction begin!"
A curtain opened, and a majestic table, mechanized using formations, appeared on the stage. On top of it lay a dagger, rusted and worn out, appearing ordinary at first glance.
"For our first item in this annual auction, ladies and gentlemen, a dagger from the Forbidden Grounds. I think we all know anything from the Forbidden Grounds holds some value.
Well, this dagger is from there, and although it’s rusted, it’s still an Earth-grade treasure.
The bid will start at 10,000 Spirit Stones, with a minimum increment of 1,000 Spirit Stones."
The moment she started the bid, voices began echoing across the hall.
The bids kept rising, showing that people truly wanted that dagger despite its rusted state. Kent was left looking at the dagger with a blank expression.
"You’re wondering what the Forbidden Grounds is, right?" Gate Master Camilla said, watching Kent’s expression. Kent smiled, showing he was indeed curious about it.
"Just like the Ancient Battlefield of Partiing, the Forbidden Grounds was said to be home to some craftsmen believed to be people from the higher heavens.
They crafted mostly weapons and traps. Nobody knew what happened, but one day, they left, and their home became a place where people who could circumvent their traps went to look for treasures.
Many died trying to explore that place, so due to the high mortality rate, they named it the Forbidden Grounds. But as you can see, people want that dagger.
It’s because no blacksmith or artisan in the four kingdoms could match their talent. Most of the bidders are blacksmiths who want to buy and study it."
"I see," Kent nodded. A while later, the rusty dagger was sold for 69,000 Spirit Stones.

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Start of the First Bidding War {Gift Bonus - s}
paragraphs: ’Blacksmiths who once lived here but are now in the heavens,’ Kent pondered on what Gate Master Camilla had said.
According to his master, before the Parting, there were beings far stronger than the current limit of this world.
However, most fell during the Battle of the Parting, and some, after the Parting, were not seen or heard from again.
Obviously, this had something to do with universal intervention. They made sure limits were placed on this world and others like it.
When Kent obtained the arrow from the Green Gate Bazaar, he learned of the ancient Battle of the Parting. Now, he was starting to learn something new, and perhaps this would lead him to some answers.
The first was what happens to those who reach the limit of this world.
He must ascend, as per the roadmap he was following. It was necessary so he could continue his mission. But so far, he didn’t know how to go about that.
Of course, he knew the Universe would one day give him the answer but learning a few things on his own was good.
’I will hold on for now. But when I am nearing the stage to ascend, I won’t just sit without finding answers.
Also, I must enter the ancient battlefield of the Parting. Who knows what awaits me there? Even if nothing is there for me, I can still learn more about the world before the Parting.’
More items were brought to the stage, but Kent wasn’t interested in any of them. He could easily buy the same things from the Tower shop using Tower points, so he let the others bid on them.

In fact, the first dozen items that were brought out were things he really didn’t care for. He wasn’t bored, though, simply because Alina was the auctioneer, so he enjoyed just watching her do her thing.
But he also had to strike up a conversation with the ladies since his other mission was to get to know them and build some trust between them.
"So, do you ladies plan on ascending beyond this world?" Kent asked, causing the ladies to turn toward him.
"Ascend, as in rising above the level of the Kingdom Protectors?" Gate Master Mara asked, looking at Kent as though he had just asked something forbidden.

"I don’t know who these Kingdom Protectors are, but yes, I’m talking about rising to a stage where this world wouldn’t be able to contain you anymore, so you would have to ascend to a higher world where you can continue your growth."
The Kingdom Protectors are beings sitting at the pinnacle of this world, and their main job is acting as the kingdom’s last defence.
There are four of them on the human continent, each from the four kingdoms. Nobody has seen them before, but they are there.
Well, nobody would recognize them simply because even if they met them, they wouldn’t know who they were. They are the strongest for a reason.

"I’ve heard from people that some have transcended from this world before using the Ascension Stone. It was something akin to a teleportation stone that transported them to a random higher world, or so they said.
However, I’ve only heard about it—I’ve never seen it with my own two eyes.
But as for whether I want to ascend or not, if I ever reach that stage and have the means, of course, I would want to ascend. But for now, I don’t have the means, so I won’t look that far ahead."
"Don’t worry about it. If you remain a good girl, I’ll take you along when I ascend," Kent said, making the two Gate Masters and the rude Saintess roll their eyes.
They brushed it off as though he had just told the biggest joke in the universe. If only they knew he was serious and would actually be ascending sooner than anyone could imagine.
"By the way, Saintess Val, can you look toward VIP room 34 and smile?" Kent said, making the Saintess look at him weirdly.
"Trust me. Look and smile."
The Saintess sighed and did as she was told.
Inside VIP room 34, Elder Cecil, one of the elders who came to the Divine Palace sect to demand her return, clenched her fist and gritted her teeth.
Her gaze met Kent’s, who smiled and mouthed a word that nearly made the elder explode out of her room and jump at him.
’How have you been?’
Talk about someone who already has a Pill Saint as an enemy; now, he has an entire sect after him, and instead of lying low, he was already infuriating them.
The Gate Masters, who saw what he did, could only sigh and plan a better punishment for him after he helped them save their disciple and sister.
For now, they would protect him against the devil if it came down to it. But afterwards, all the trouble he had caused would be offloaded onto him in the most painful way possible.
"For our next auction item," Alina’s voice suddenly echoed through the auction hall, causing Kent to turn his attention there. He could sense something powerful about to be auctioned.
The elegant mechanized table moved forward, and sitting atop it was a treasure that caught everyone’s attention. They could sense a powerful energy emanating from it.
They all wanted it, for even if they didn’t know its purpose, they knew it was something valuable.

"This is the Wishing Star Fragment. It’s a fragment from a fallen star that is said to be guarded by powerful spirit beasts—so formidable that even a Root Sovereign stage expert wouldn’t have an easy time facing them.
A group of explorers found this piece, brave enough to venture into the Ancient Battlefield of Parting. We don’t know what it’s made of, but we can all tell it is a treasure beyond treasures.
The starting bid is 900,000 spirit stones, with increments of 50,000 spirit stones.
The bidding starts now."
Alina declared, and everyone began throwing money into the air.
[Master, you must get this at all costs,] Gaia spoke, but Kent was already ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Intense Battle
paragraphs: "2,000,000 spirit stones..."
"3,000,000 spirit stones..."
"5,000,000 spirit stones..."
The bidding war had just begun, and the price had risen to a level where many had dropped out, leaving only the big shots in the VIP rooms.
They all wanted the fragment from space.
Everyone knew anything from outer space was valuable, so hearing it was a fragment of a star, they all wanted it. In fact, many had already inquired if anyone knew those who had found it.
From what Alina said, this adult head-sized fragment was from the main body of the real thing. Obviously, hearing that Root Sovereign stage spirit beasts protected it didn’t seem to deter them.
They wanted it, and they were willing to pay a huge price for it.
Kent was the same. He needed that fragment, considering what his enchanted eyes were showing was something he couldn’t pass up.
⟪Dark Void Stone⟫
→ A fragment of the Dark Void Star, broken off after a collision with another star.
→ It contains a very durable metal ore that, when fashioned into a weapon, inherits the hardening aspect of the Dark Void Star.
→ If used properly, the weapon will gain some properties of the void.
Reading the description of the fragment brought a smile to his face. The battle doll in his possession came to mind.
Right now, it was a Root Great Sage-level doll. However, with what he was seeing from this treasure, Kent could tell the doll would gain some serious upgrades if this fragment was used to enhance it.
One good thing about having battle dolls was that you only needed treasures like this to increase their strength. Of course, you would require blacksmiths to do that.
But Kent had the Tower, so he wasn’t worried.
In fact, he had already tried buying some of these treasures from the Tower shop, but the prices weren’t something he could easily afford.𝚏𝕣𝕖𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚋𝚗𝐨𝐯𝕖𝕝.𝕔𝐨𝕞
Now, a rather good opportunity had appeared. But aside from that, he already had something he would be asking Alina this evening after the auction.
The location of the real thing, he wants it. If he could retrieve more of this, he wouldn’t only be able to upgrade dozens of battle dolls; he could use fragments to create more powerful undead.
He basically has more use for this star fragment than even the blacksmiths.
Thus, Kent chose to watch as they battled over the item. He wouldn’t be joining now; he would wait for them to narrow down their numbers before he jumped in.
"Most of these people are some of the famous blacksmiths in the four continents. I wonder who is going to win this bid," Unity said, having witnessed such battles before when she was Lilian’s maid.
This exposed her to a lot of influential people.
Now, watching the battle between them, she couldn’t help but wonder how it would end. All the ladies shared the same thoughts.
Kent just smiled but didn’t say anything and continued to watch the battle, which went on for an hour until only three people were left still bidding.
The price had reached 50 million, yet it kept increasing. The battle for the star fragment is the first real bidding war, so everyone is enjoying it.
"55 million," a bulky man with arms that could snap the life out of anyone shouted in a deep tone. He doesn’t need an introduction to know he raises a lot of hammers.
A blacksmith.
"Isn’t that the Saint Blacksmith from the Kyrrith Kingdom?" one person whispered, but almost everyone heard it.
"Indeed, it’s Metal Saint Rocky," another person said, and just like that, the identity of one of the 14 Saint Blacksmiths in the human continent was revealed.
The 14 are the backbone of blacksmithing in the human continent.
"60 million," another person said, making everyone wonder who the second person was.
"That is Metal Saint Andrew. He is also from the Kyrrith Kingdom, and from the rumours going around, he and Metal Saint Rocky are rivals in everything.
Clearly, we will see a good fight here today. This will be good to watch," Another person said cheerfully.

When one starts off, they are just known as Common, Adept, and the like; however, when they reach the Grandmaster stage, they will gain the title "Metal" to their name.
Metal Grandmaster Kent, for example.
This also means anyone with a "Metal" title to their name is someone worthy of respect. So, to see the two get into a bidding war, they are all expecting a good fight.
"70 million!" Suddenly, a third voice entered the fray, causing everyone to look at VIP Room 4.
"That is Metal Saint Adolf from the Athea Kingdom. He is also the head of the Blacksmith Association in the Athea Kingdom. This keeps getting fun!"
"Metal Saint Adolf, the same blacksmith who crafted the first-ever Heaven-grade treasure... He is actually in this year’s auction and even here on the first day. This is wild!"

The auction hall turned into murmurs as everyone discussed the sudden discovery that three of the 14 Metal Saints were actually in attendance and were bidding in what appeared to be the first of many bidding wars to happen within the three days of the auction.
This is wild, and everyone in attendance can tell that. People like the three metal saints mostly appear on the third day when all the crazy stuff would be auctioned.
So, all three appearing on the first day can be considered a wild encounter.
"80 million!" Metal Saint Rocky shouted from his VIP room, causing everyone to look toward the two other VIP rooms.
"85 million..." Metal Saint Andrew threw in his bid, raising the bid by 5 million.
"You two kids should let this big brother have this," Metal Saint Adolf said before stating his bid. "90 million."
"Why don’t you let this junior brother have it instead? I am working on a piece, and this fragment would be a good addition to it," the bulky Rocky also said.
"100 million," he raised the bid by ten million.
Metal Saint Adolf gritted his teeth, hearing such a huge raise from the bulky blacksmith.
"This is not going to end well for the three of us, so why don’t I have this? I know there will be other opportunities, considering this isn’t the last item for today.
If you let me have this, I won’t fight over the next item. How does that sound?"
"110 million," Metal Saint Andrew proposed, but the two weren’t about to lose such a treasure. They wanted the treasure, and if it meant going to war over it for an entire day, then so be it.
Unfortunately, someone with no idea how to spend his money was just waiting for this moment to shatter their dreams.
The price rose to 140 million, but they weren’t about to stop. So, the dragon stepped in.
"Since you three seniors couldn’t come up with a compromise, then I will be taking the ore from your hands. 600 million," Kent said, and jaws dropped.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: A Wise Man Once Said...
paragraphs: They say when you are given a fish but don’t know what to do with it, the cat will take it from you, and there will be no replacement.
That was what had happened to the three blacksmiths who couldn’t decide who would take the Void Stone.
They kept battling over it for an hour, but even so, the price was only in the 100 million plus range. It wasn’t like they were mentioning significantly larger numbers.
Of course, this was more than enough for anyone to raise their chin and see them as heavy spenders.
This also means they are doing this not because they lack the money but to show everyone they have the means to do so.
So, Kent broke the momentum, and the aftereffect was just too much.
"600 million. Is there any other bid?" Alina said, smiling to herself when she heard Kent’s bid.
In fact, after his bid, everyone went blank, not knowing what to say.
Of course, a few who had more control over their reactions recognized this as someone breaking the flow, so naturally, they turned their attention to VIP Room 13.
"Who is that person, and why did he dare break the battle between three Saint Blacksmiths?" someone asked while everyone turned toward Kent’s VIP room.
They all wanted to see a good fight, but the momentum being broken was just too heartbreaking for those who want a bidding war
"I would like to know the senior who wants to take this ore off our hands," Metal Saint Andrew said, looking in Kent’s direction.
Perhaps one could not see it, but Kent saw and felt it; the blacksmith was using his energy to size him up. However, he wasn’t afraid of him, mainly because he had two Root Transcendents on his side.
"I am not a senior; I merely wanted the ore for my own purposes," Kent said, causing everyone in the hall to look at him strangely.
"Then I would like to let this junior know that this Metal Ore is something we blacksmiths need for our craft.
If this junior doesn’t mind, perhaps we can have it?" Metal Saint Andrew asked again, maintaining his calm expression and demeanour.

"No can do. Like I said, I also have a use for it. Normally, I would have accepted, but what I need it for is something I cannot delay in hopes of getting lucky again," Kent replied, knowing three people were about to take offence.
As expected, a soul attack landed on his soul right when he said those words. There are formations, but a soul attack from a Root Transcendent holds some strength in it.
It passed through the formations and landed on him.
Kent just smirked. Even Elsa smirked and asked Kent if she should retaliate, but he said no.

"Juniors should make way for the seniors to have what they need because through them, it’s true that we all can learn something new," Elder Cecil from the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect spoke, causing many to nod in agreement.
She wasn’t about to let three blacksmiths take a loss like she did, so she chose to fan the flames.
"True, as a junior, you should let your seniors have this. This way, you will even earn their good graces," another figure spoke from a VIP room.
"Spoken like a true scholar. Indeed, juniors should let their seniors have this, and perhaps, this will help them build relationships faster and better."
While the people began speaking in favour of the three blacksmiths, another soul attack came from Metal Saint Andrew, who just couldn’t believe Kent had survived the first attack.
No, it was more like his attack had struck the hardest metal. There was no damage whatsoever when he attacked.
Elsa was just asking for the go-ahead to launch her own attack, considering she was sensing the attacks coming at Kent.
However, he said no. Instead, he looked toward the ore one last time.
"You know, a wise man once said, if you want to win at the auction house, be sure to have enough money."
"One billion."
Kent raised the price to the next level, showing everyone that he not only cared little for subtle threats but also had the money to back up his arrogance and disrespect.
Alina, who never expected that amount to be mentioned, looked toward Kent’s booth and sighed inwardly. But then reality kicked in, and she smiled.
"Price set at one billion. Are there any more offers?" she asked, but even after 30 seconds, nobody said a word.
"The item is sold to the gentleman in VIP room 13," Alina announced, and everyone looked in Kent’s direction.
Two things had now occurred, and each was equally shocking.
Not only had he bought the item for a billion, but he had also disregarded the threats from the powerful figures and went ahead to purchase the metal ore from the three Metal Saints.
It was like standing at the centre of the auction house and raising a middle finger at everyone.
Alina, who was now smiling for selling a billion-dollar item on her first day, began to sense the hostile energies rising from the VIP boxes.
"I would like to point out that this is an auction house where the rich have all the say using their money. He bought the item because he has the funds, so lets all respect that.
However, if you have any grievances to settle with him after the auction, please be sure to take it outside of the auction house.
If you do otherwise while in here, you will not only be removed regardless of your background, but you will also be banned from all Silver Leaf auction houses in the four kingdoms."
Alina’s words were like the voice of a god. Just those few sentences brought calm to the auction house. As she said, while inside the auction house, the rich hold the power.
But outside, only the strong can have a say.
Obviously, Kent could see powerhouses already making moves in the background.
They all wanted that ore, and since it was no longer in the hands of any of the three Metal Saints, the chances of obtaining it had significantly increased.
The next item was brought up for auction.

chapters.title: Chapter 291: End of Day One
paragraphs: Gate Master Mara stared at Kent like she had seen the rarest breed in existence. Kent’s actions just baffle her...
"You do know they will come after you after the auction," she said, looking at the smiling brat who had just angered an entire auction of rich and powerful people.
"You could have let them have the ore. Why go to this length?" she asked, and Kent smiled.
"I need it more than they do," Kent answered, still maintaining his composure.
"What at all do you need a meteorite for? Considering the last time I checked, you are not a blacksmith," she asked again, not understanding how Kent could be this reckless.
"It’s true, I am not a blacksmith, but if your opponent is an evil practitioner, you need all the tools to win. Now, I have secured something that will push me closer to my goal.
As for them, they can come. I happen to be in need of dead bodies. Coming after me will be like a blessing in disguise," Kent said, and the expression on the Gate Master’s face changed.

Hearing the mention of an evil practitioner meant Kent had only angered these people because of that. If it had been the other way around, he wouldn’t have angered people he simply couldn’t afford to anger.
But hearing he did all this because he was planning for his rescue mission calmed her down. She would have done some if she were in his shoes.
Kent noticed the change in her expression and smiled.
"Don’t worry, Gate Master. They won’t be able to get to me before I do anything to them," Kent spoke with confidence.
Obviously, right after the auction, he would run into the tower and only come out tomorrow. He couldn’t face all these bastards on his own, so the best way was to use his tower to his advantage.
But those who would come after him would be met with a nasty surprise.
Someone with resources such as his shouldn’t take things lying down. Since he had the money and bought the item, he should be allowed to use it without fearing for his life.
For now, Kent was just waiting for them to come.
The next item was brought out and auctioned for 10 million spirit stones. It was a herb that could strengthen a man’s libido when used as the main ingredient to concoct the Sex Enhancement Pill.
This brought back old memories.
When Vexthra sent him to this world, he appeared in the home of a certain alchemist who had died while concocting a pill.
The pill was the Sex Enhancement Pill he had been planning to use on Lilian.
Back then, she was poisoned, and somehow, that bastard had managed to get a hint that some alchemists would be summoned.
Whoever managed to cure her would get to make her their wife.
Obviously, the bastard alchemist was confident he could cure her, so he had already started making preparations.
Unfortunately, he died before he could fulfil his dreams.
Thankfully, Kent, who in a way had become his disciple, managed to fulfil his master’s dream and made Lilian his woman.
After the herb, another herb was brought out, but the alchemists swarmed it. Kent wasn’t really in need of them, so he let the rest have it.
His focus was on something he could use now for his rescue mission.
Saintess Val bought a heaven-grade flying sword that had been retrieved from a smithy in the forbidden grounds.
The sword was far better than the ones she had been using, so she bought it after a 30-minute battle with another Sword Saint from one of the prestigious sects, the Golden Light Sect.
It was an intense battle, but the Sword Saint lost simply because the Saintess she was battling against wasn’t spending her own money.
She was using Kent’s moment, so she kept going until the Saint backed out.
She bought it for 67 million, and Kent handed her the money to go collect it after the auction.
Perhaps the ladies inside all wanted this moment, so after the rude Saintess, who wasn’t really paying attention to anyone, dug into Kent’s money, the rest started to get lively.
Gate Master Camilla bought a brazier she wouldn’t be using, but she planned to save it for her disciple after she was rescued.
Unity also bought an arrow for 45 million after battling over it with an archer from the Eagle Eye Bow Sect.
But just like with Saintess Val, the disciple lost because she was competing against someone who had an infinite amount of money, thanks to her man being rich.
Later on, the item for the last day of the auction was brought out.
It was an armour that had been taken from the Ancient Battlefield of Parting. It was damaged on one side, but its durability remained intact, and it was even a Heaven-grade item.
Kent scanned it, but after reading the details, he realized it wasn’t something he was interested in.
This time, too, there was a fierce battle between the three Metal Saints.
During the battle, everyone was checking to see if Kent would join in, but after 45 minutes of intense bidding, Metal Saint Andrew won the bid after bidding a whopping 230 million spirit stones.
Though it was too much for a damaged armour, if he were to repair it—and he planned on doing so—its grade would rise to Legendary, making it even more impressive.
After the last item, Alina addressed everyone.
"That will be the last of the items for today. All those who won a bid should come to the back office to pay and collect them. We accept no refunds, so you get what you pay for.
Tomorrow, we will be auctioning 50 items, of which 44 are Heaven-grade, 4 are Legendary-grade, 1 heaven-defying pill, and, well, the last one... we can only wait to see what it is.
Thank you for coming to day one of this year’s Annual Auction. See you tomorrow at 10 a.m."
After she said that, everyone began to disperse, with those who won bids moving to pay and collect their items.
Kent and the ladies moved out, and immediately, eyes locked onto them, tracking their every movement.
Obviously, they were about to learn why you shouldn’t offend powerful people during an auction.

Tomorrow, we will be auctioning 50 items, of which 44 are Heaven-grade, 4 are Legendary-grade, 1 heaven-defying pill, and, well, the last one... we can only wait to see what it is.
Thank you for coming to day one of this year’s Annual Auction.
See you tomorrow at 10 a.m."
After she said that, everyone began to disperse, with those who won bids moving to pay and collect their items.
Kent and the ladies moved out, and immediately, eyes locked onto them, tracking their every movement.
Obviously, they were about to learn why you shouldn’t offend powerful people during an auction.

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Center of Attention {Gift Bonus - s}
paragraphs: Before the auction ended for the first day, Kent placed the last spider in the shadow of a maid serving the millers in VIP room 12. They shared boundaries with him, so he was able to easily bug them.
And that was how Kent now knew his life was in danger the moment the auction was over.
In VIP room 14, he overheard the plot crafted by Bright Faywoon.
The plan was simple: after Kent paid for the ore he won over the three Metal Saints, they would attack in the evening and claim it.
Apparently, they didn’t care if two Root Transcendents were protecting him.
They came prepared, and even long before the auction was over, he had sent messages to their backups, someone in Vastport City, to start looking for the hotel booked by Kent and his company.
He planned to use three more Root Transcendents on top of the two with him in the auction house to suppress the two gate masters and get to the brat who chose the wrong time to flaunt his wealth.
Then, on the other side, the millers he had bugged had other plans.
They were eyeing the ladies with Kent, and from what he heard, they still hadn’t learned from their mistakes with what happened to their heir.
This alone started fuelling his determination to get them eradicated within a month.
They wanted to get their hands on them and sell them as slaves. From the glint in their voice as they spoke, Kent could tell their son that Alina killed was perhaps a saint.
This made him change his mind about everything. This time, he will give them a nasty surprise. His initial plan was to enter the tower after getting back to the hotel.
But now, things have changed, so he will wait for them to come.
As he moved to claim his bid, eyes were on him, but he didn’t care. He entered the small office where a lady with three Root Transcendents as her guard was waiting.
"Distinguished buyer, please wait here while we take care of the order for you." The moment Kent entered, the lady said, gesturing toward a chair.
Kent nodded and sat down.
A few seconds later, a golden box was brought from the inner room. She set it on the table and opened it. Inside is a dark stone about the size of an adult’s head.
Kent looked at it and nodded.
He then took out a pouch containing the billion stones and handed it over to her. The lady accepted the pouch with a cute smile.

The percentage they will be earning from Kent’s buy alone is more than enough to cover their profit for the entire auction. It will cover the entire three-day auction, even if he doesn’t over-purchase again.
"Nice doing business with you," Kent said before walking away.
He stored the case in his tower storage and moved to join his ladies, who had already finished claiming their items.
They then started making their way back to the hotel. It was a five-star hotel that had been booked in advance. Along the way, the auras of powerful people could be sensed following them.
Kent was rather smiling, considering the aura of over a dozen Root Transcendents could be felt locking down on him and his ladies.
By the time they got to the hotel, over three dozen people were following them. Kent led them inside, and shortly after, they appeared inside a large suite where they all had their rooms.
However, instead of entering their rooms, Kent stopped them and asked a question he had already discussed with Gaia.
The plan was to use the auction to get to know the three ladies who had joined the team. Gate Master Mara, Camilla, and the Rude Saintess were the three he planned on getting to know.
He didn’t want to introduce them to the tower just yet, considering he didn’t trust them.
But things were different now.
The danger following them was not something he could ignore.
They were not only targeting him now. They most certainly had their eyes set on his ladies and the three women with him. Kent, in particular, wouldn’t let any harm come to them.
So he and Gaia had discussed the possibility of the three ladies betraying him. But at the end of it, they arrived at the same conclusion.
None of the three ladies had any reason to betray him.
Saintess Val now seemed to have accepted her new home, considering she now had a large pool of money she could use however she wanted.
She wouldn’t go against that.
Then there are the two gate masters.
Gate master Mara, in particular, has more reason not to betray him. The first was the fact that Kent would be helping her rescue her sister.
The second is Selene. She was her disciple before she became a Saintess, so in a way, she wouldn’t betray the man her former disciple had chosen as her life partner.
Though she would enjoy torturing him, she wouldn’t do that now. Kent was just too valuable to her.
As for Gate Master Camilla, she had already fully trusted Kent. This was because of her precious disciple, now trapped and waiting to be rescued.
In a way, Kent would, without a doubt, save her, considering he had already made contact right under the nose of the sect master.
So she wouldn’t betray him.
This was why Kent was about to send them to the tower for today. He would send a very clear message to those having funny ideas.
"Ladies, we may have angered some serious people, and now, they are all after us," Kent said, smiling.
"You angered them, not us," Saintess Val said.
"Still, they wouldn’t spare you when they come for me, so we are all in trouble. However, I have a fix. I will be sending you ladies somewhere. Now, before we do that, you must sign this document."

Obviously, Akira, who was spying on his and Gaia’s conversation, had offered a good plan that required the ladies to sign an NDA. This way, if they dared to speak of what they were about to see, their souls would be in trouble.
The three ladies stared at him with varied expressions, but in the end, they sighed.
"Master, make them feel comfortable," Kent said, sending them to the harem tower and leaving only him on the outside.
"Then again, they are asking for what is about to happen," he muttered. An evil smile appeared on his lips as he vanished into the tower store.
