chapters.title: Chapter 293: Nasty Welcome
paragraphs: Kent sent the ladies away, leaving Selene in charge to handle the thousands of questions they would have. He also knew the shameless sword saintess was the right person that pollute the ladies.
The end game is to get them in the harem, and since his ladies are keen on making that happen, he can only let them handle it.
His focus now was on the visitors he was about to receive.
After he won the bid, he and Gaia had already started forming plans on how to counter the danger that would come to them.
The auction would last for three days, and if they were attacked on the first day, that would just be too bad.
He had to change that.
Who knows what would be sold on the second and third days that might cause these people to get any funny ideas?
So the plan was to ensure that after today, none of them would have any funny ideas.
He appeared inside the Tower shop, where Gaia was waiting for him with a list of things he would be buying.
"Are you sure this can even handle a Root Transcendent?" Kent asked.
[Yes, master. Though they wouldn’t die inhaling it immediately, they wouldn’t know they have been poisoned until it’s too late. So today, whoever enters your room will have a nasty welcome.]
"That is good for me. I want them to start panicking by morning." Kent smiled easily and selected the colorless and odorless bone poison.
Just one vial cost 500,000 tower points, but it was guaranteed to kill even a Root Transcendent, so he didn’t bat an eye, spending 2 million TP to buy four.
"How about the dummies?" Kent asked, and Gaia showed him a replica of Unity.
[Though it’s not perfect, the dummy will be able to trick the eye into thinking she is the real one. All you have to do is ensure it is covered and cannot be easily figured out.]
"That is good too. So Unity, Lilian, Elsa, and Saintess Val will stay in one room. Gate Master Mara and Camilla will also be in another room, while Selene, Neomi, and Ingrid will have their own room.
I will also be in my room. This way, when the poison is administered, it will take over the four rooms. I am sure I will be getting some dead bodies today."
[The master can just sit and relax. This marker will imprint on the people, so even when they die outside your rooms, they will be teleported to the Necro-smith Forge.]
The plan was to get the dead bodies at the end of the day, so even if they managed to go back to their masters, the moment they died, their bodies would vanish into the NecroSmith Gorge.
Kent is a Creator Necromancer, after all.
"That is good for me. Now, let’s set things up." Kent appeared inside the room and immediately started setting the stage for the welcome party he had prepared for the intruders.
His welcome ceremony was in the form of a nasty welcome.
After a few minutes, the stage was set, and he went back inside the tower to observe, thanks to Gaia giving him a third-person view.
Four hours after he set the stage, five people appeared inside the room and immediately took action. Three went after the ladies, while two went after Kent.
However, a few seconds later, four of them dropped dead, with the fifth trying to get away. But before he could do that, the battle doll appeared and stabbed him through the heart, killing him.
Kent smiled, feeling five bodies appear inside the Necrosmith Forge.
They were all Great Sages, so their resistance wasn’t that high against the poison, which affected the bones first and slowly did all kinds of nasty things to them.
He waited, and an hour later, the goons from the Miller family appeared.
This made Kent wonder why a new set of people would choose to come, knowing they wouldn’t be the other ones coming after him and his ladies this evening.
He knew for a fact that all these people trying to get the ore were aware they were racing against others, so why the hell did they have to appear when those who went in didn’t come out?
He was sure they could sense each other and knew their are against a competition. So when one entered but didn’t return, why didn’t the second, third, and fourth go back?
Why not know this was a trap that must be avoided?
The answer to that question was simple: greed.
Greed can make one lose all sense of reason and do stupid things that have no benefit whatsoever to their lives.
Greed made the first group lose their lives, and greed will make more to die, for all those who enter the four rooms for the next couple of hours are bound to die.
Kent could only watch as five Root Great Sages and three Root Transcendents entered. A few seconds later, they came out looking pale.
The three Root Transcendents were visibly shaken, while the five Root Sages died instantly, not knowing what had happened.
As for the three, they tried to walk away. Well, two walked away simply because the doll ended one of them.
But 20 minutes later, he felt the two who got away appear inside his NecroSmith Forge, and that was when he sensed he had made a good harvest, even if the night didn’t go as planned.
The first plan was to eat dinner with the ladies and then spend some time with them, as they had planned to keep him up all night.
But this was also good.
After the auction, if he wanted, he could use a part of the fragment, mixed with spirit stones and the dead bodies, to create undead.
He knew for a fact they would be somewhere between Root Great Sages and Root Transcendents in strength.
But this harvest was good. When day two came, he would buy all the items that could be used inside the Necro Forge.
He needed the undead for his missions, especially now that these people chose to deliver dead bodies to him.
A necromancer’s favorite gift is a graveyard and dead bodies. In Kent’s case, he was now getting the dead bodies handed to him on a silver platter.
Three more teams came, but none returned alive. Those who did couldn’t live past 30 minutes. In the end, Kent got 25 Root Great Sages and 7 Root Transcendent bodies, and the rest was history.
He waited until there was only an hour left before the next day’s auction before entering the Harem Gate.
That would give him a day inside to have a chat with the Gate Masters, who, in a way, felt touched that Kent chose to trust them with such a secret.
Their trust level moved to over 80%, something that, if there were a meter, would have shocked Kent. It was a simple gesture on one end. He even made them sign some silly papers.
But that had made him gain two powerful allies he could count on. Selene did a good job answering their questions to the best of her abilities.
As for the rude Saintess, she just wanted to stay in the Love Garden for the rest of her life.
The Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect could forget about ever getting their Saintess back. She had fallen quite fast.

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Building Trust Before Thrust
paragraphs: "Kent, what happened? Did they come? What happened to them? Are you hurt?" Gate Master Mara asked a series of questions when Kent appeared inside the love garden.
He smiled and shook his head.

"Thanks for the concern, Gate Master, but I am fine. As for our guests, they did come, but let’s just say that from tomorrow onwards, everyone with motives against us will think twice before coming after us," Kent said as he sat down.
"What did you do?" she asked again, but instead of answering, Kent posed a question in a statement-like manner.
"Gate Master, do you know it’s quite a hassle to kill a Root Transcendent?" Kent asked.
The ladies who heard what he said wore shocked expressions on their faces. Was he implying that he had killed a Root Transcendent? Just how was he able to do that?
That question appeared in their minds, and one had to give it to Kent—he knew how to steer the conversation.
"Don’t tell me you killed a Root Transcendent. That’s not possible, right?" Gate Master Camilla said, unwilling to accept this outcome.
"Let’s not dwell on that. The most important question is, how are you ladies liking the place?" Kent smiled.
Since the so-called powerhouses wouldn’t be able to come out and accuse him of killing their warriors, he can only brush this aside and continue with his life.

"We have been in here for days now, but according to Saintess Selene, time runs differently here. Was she telling the truth, or have we indeed been in here for days already?" Saintess Val asked, chewing on a fruit she had plucked a couple of hours ago.
"That is true, what she said. The time here runs differently compared to the time on the outside. A day here is an hour out there," Kent answered, causing the three ladies to look at each other.
A few seconds later, they sighed.
"And you chose to trust us with this place. Though you made us sign that thing, I still wouldn’t shown anyone this place," Gate Master Mara said.

"Call it me being stupid and choosing to trust you three. But I also cannot see a reason not to trust you. So, if you trust me enough and choose to keep this a secret, then know that it is just one of the many things I will be introducing you ladies to. You’ve already seen what I can do, so all I ask is your trust," Kent said.
The universe had helped him gain the trust of the Spear Saintess. But from that, Kent learned some lessons, so though this wasn’t the best approach in the eyes of many, he saw it as a necessary move.
"Thank you for trusting us. I don’t know about the two of them, but know that I will never break this trust," Gate Master Mara said.

"Same here. I have nothing to gain from exposing something this powerful about you. But even if I did, what would I get from it? It’s not like I even know what this place is," Gate Master Camilla added.
"After we leave, can we come back again? I want to come back here," Saintess Val, who had already chosen the garden as her favourite place, had already forgotten about her sect.
"Don’t worry, you will get the chance. After all, you are my servant," Kent smiled. "By the way, do you now accept me as your master and choose to become my servant?" Kent asked.
"Whatever, it’s not like I can reject you now anyway," she shrugged, but everyone could tell she was just faking it. She was indeed more than happy to take him as her master.
’Gaia, add her to the servant tower,’ Kent ordered, and Gaia obeyed.
She was added to the tower and felt something change about her, but she was too absorbed in eating her fruit to examine it.
Kent looked at her profile and found out she was a Level 2 Root Great Sage. Surprisingly, her spirit root grade was Gold, just a step away from Platinum.
This also made Kent realize that though he had become a monster, he couldn’t handle his master in a fair duel.
Comparing her to Saintess Val is an insult to her.
The lady had a Copper-grade spirit root but managed to rise to a level many Platinum-grade cultivators couldn’t. She became a Saintess thanks to her hard work and brilliance.
It was as if she had proven to everyone that spirit roots aren’t everything.
Kent looked through the details about her, considering everything about her was laid before him to read.
The moment you are added to the tower, everything about you will be known by the Master of the tower. Kent is like a god inside the tower.
He was shocked by some of her details, but her trust level meter shocked him the most.
⟪Name: Saintess Valerie Jbox Adle⟫
⟪Role: Servant⟫
⟪Trust level: 89%⟫
→ She is eligible to have a true name. Awaken it using a true name token.
Kent was shocked reading this. The rude lady trusted him that much? He was stunned seeing this. He quickly asked Gaia a question.
’Gaia, would she have a different True Name if she becomes my woman, or are the names the same regardless of where she was given?’
Since she was now his servant, he wanted to know if the true names were assigned based on the tower they were linked to.
[No, Master. She only has one True Name, just like Uncle Drew and Elsa already had theirs. All the tower does is assign them these True Names and help them awaken and invoke them.
She will get the same True Name regardless of which tower she was linked to. The Master should check his lady’s profile; he will understand what I mean.]
Kent nodded inwardly and did as he was told.
Right now, he wanted his ladies to start walking their paths and awaken their True Names. Though the price for a true name token is rather high, he could afford it.
The only reason he was holding back was what Gaia said. They must first start walking their path.
Saintess Selene’s path is ready for her to start walking. Kent will take her there after the auctions.
By then, Gaia will be done with the one for the Spear Saintess, Ingrid, Lilian, Alina and now, a quest appeared again after making Val his servant.
This quest will reward him with a path for Elsa. Though he had already awakened her true name, making her someone currently walking the path of an Aether Warden, a path is being created for her.
This was why when Gaia asked him to check their profiles, he was shocked to see some changes appear now.
He checked Lilian, Selene, Ingrid, Neomi, Alina, and Unity. They were all eligible; all he needed was a True Name token.
However, Unity had something different. Her True Name could be awakened by something called a Destiny Token. Kent wanted to ask about it, but for some reason, he held back.
He didn’t know why he had to do that, but he knew things about her were about to get critical.
"So, Kent, are they all your women?" Gate Master Camilla suddenly asked, snapping Kent back to reality.

sentences.text: "Kent, what happened?
Did they come?
What happened to them?
Are you hurt?" Gate Master Mara asked a series of questions when Kent appeared inside the love garden.
He smiled and shook his head.
"Thanks for the concern, Gate Master, but I am fine.
As for our guests, they did come, but let’s just say that from tomorrow onwards, everyone with motives against us will think twice before coming after us," Kent said as he sat down.
"What did you do?" she asked again, but instead of answering, Kent posed a question in a statement-like manner.
"Gate Master, do you know it’s quite a hassle to kill a Root Transcendent?" Kent asked.
The ladies who heard what he said wore shocked expressions on their faces.
Was he implying that he had killed a Root Transcendent?
Just how was he able to do that?
That question appeared in their minds, and one had to give it to Kent—he knew how to steer the conversation.
"Don’t tell me you killed a Root Transcendent.
That’s not possible, right?" Gate Master Camilla said, unwilling to accept this outcome.
"Let’s not dwell on that.
The most important question is, how are you ladies liking the place?" Kent smiled.
Since the so-called powerhouses wouldn’t be able to come out and accuse him of killing their warriors, he can only brush this aside and continue with his life.
"We have been in here for days now, but according to Saintess Selene, time runs differently here.
Was she telling the truth, or have we indeed been in here for days already?" Saintess Val asked, chewing on a fruit she had plucked a couple of hours ago.
"That is true, what she said.
The time here runs differently compared to the time on the outside.
A day here is an hour out there," Kent answered, causing the three ladies to look at each other.
A few seconds later, they sighed.
"And you chose to trust us with this place.
Though you made us sign that thing, I still wouldn’t shown anyone this place," Gate Master Mara said.
"Call it me being stupid and choosing to trust you three.
But I also cannot see a reason not to trust you.
So, if you trust me enough and choose to keep this a secret, then know that it is just one of the many things I will be introducing you ladies to.
You’ve already seen what I can do, so all I ask is your trust," Kent said.
The universe had helped him gain the trust of the Spear Saintess.
But from that, Kent learned some lessons, so though this wasn’t the best approach in the eyes of many, he saw it as a necessary move.
"Thank you for trusting us.
I don’t know about the two of them, but know that I will never break this trust," Gate Master Mara said.
"Same here.
I have nothing to gain from exposing something this powerful about you.
But even if I did, what would I get from it?
It’s not like I even know what this place is," Gate Master Camilla added.
"After we leave, can we come back again?
I want to come back here," Saintess Val, who had already chosen the garden as her favourite place, had already forgotten about her sect.
"Don’t worry, you will get the chance.
After all, you are my servant," Kent smiled.
"By the way, do you now accept me as your master and choose to become my servant?" Kent asked.
"Whatever, it’s not like I can reject you now anyway," she shrugged, but everyone could tell she was just faking it.
She was indeed more than happy to take him as her master.
’Gaia, add her to the servant tower,’ Kent ordered, and Gaia obeyed.
She was added to the tower and felt something change about her, but she was too absorbed in eating her fruit to examine it.
Kent looked at her profile and found out she was a Level 2 Root Great Sage.
Surprisingly, her spirit root grade was Gold, just a step away from Platinum.
This also made Kent realize that though he had become a monster, he couldn’t handle his master in a fair duel.
Comparing her to Saintess Val is an insult to her.
The lady had a Copper-grade spirit root but managed to rise to a level many Platinum-grade cultivators couldn’t.
She became a Saintess thanks to her hard work and brilliance.
It was as if she had proven to everyone that spirit roots aren’t everything.
Kent looked through the details about her, considering everything about her was laid before him to read.
The moment you are added to the tower, everything about you will be known by the Master of the tower.
Kent is like a god inside the tower.
He was shocked by some of her details, but her trust level meter shocked him the most.
⟪Name: Saintess Valerie Jbox Adle⟫
⟪Role: Servant⟫
⟪Trust level: 89%⟫
→ She is eligible to have a true name.
Awaken it using a true name token.
Kent was shocked reading this.
The rude lady trusted him that much?
He was stunned seeing this.
He quickly asked Gaia a question.
’Gaia, would she have a different True Name if she becomes my woman, or are the names the same regardless of where she was given?’
Since she was now his servant, he wanted to know if the true names were assigned based on the tower they were linked to.
[No, Master.
She only has one True Name, just like Uncle Drew and Elsa already had theirs.
All the tower does is assign them these True Names and help them awaken and invoke them.
She will get the same True Name regardless of which tower she was linked to.
The Master should check his lady’s profile; he will understand what I mean.]
Kent nodded inwardly and did as he was told.
Right now, he wanted his ladies to start walking their paths and awaken their True Names.
Though the price for a true name token is rather high, he could afford it.
The only reason he was holding back was what Gaia said.
They must first start walking their path.
Saintess Selene’s path is ready for her to start walking.
Kent will take her there after the auctions.
By then, Gaia will be done with the one for the Spear Saintess, Ingrid, Lilian, Alina and now, a quest appeared again after making Val his servant.
This quest will reward him with a path for Elsa.
Though he had already awakened her true name, making her someone currently walking the path of an Aether Warden, a path is being created for her.
This was why when Gaia asked him to check their profiles, he was shocked to see some changes appear now.
He checked Lilian, Selene, Ingrid, Neomi, Alina, and Unity.
They were all eligible; all he needed was a True Name token.
However, Unity had something different.
Her True Name could be awakened by something called a Destiny Token.
Kent wanted to ask about it, but for some reason, he held back.
He didn’t know why he had to do that, but he knew things about her were about to get critical.
"So, Kent, are they all your women?" Gate Master Camilla suddenly asked, snapping Kent back to reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Starting Day Two with Shocked and Furious Expressions
paragraphs: Hotel staff and security were paid off to let the killer access the suite Kent, and his ladies were supposed to be in that night after the auction.
It was an easy move on their part, considering Kent’s team was the weakest in this regard.
However, when the day broke and none of their teams returned to report, questions started popping up.
The Millers, the Faywoods, the Fyad, and everyone who tried to take advantage of the situation to steal ore from Kent were now asking their spies and informants questions.
Of course, they couldn’t make these questions public, considering they shouldn’t have been asking them in the first place.
They tried to steal from someone who won the bid fair and square, so why resort to underhanded means to take from him?
But as the minutes passed and their Root Great Sages and Root Transcendents didn’t return, their frustration started to mount.
Then, as the time for the second day of the auction approached, many started arriving at the auction house.
That was when a certain golden carriage pulled up, and a purple-haired brat stepped out, helping the ladies alight as well.

Then they moved inside and went straight to VIP Room 13 under the intense gaze of hundreds of people. Some were admirers, while others were those who lost more than they bargained for the night before.
Kent just entered the auction house like it was a normal Tuesday. In fact, if one looked closely, they would see a smirk on the corner of his lips, showing he didn’t care about them anymore.

They came after him, and now, aside from obtaining ore that would perhaps help him create a Transcendent-level battle doll, he also had bodies that, if mixed with some powerful monster remains and another resource, could yield more Transcendent-level undead warriors.
One had to give it to him—with or without the universe’s help, Kent’s luck was very contagious.
He had made a good haul, and on top of that, he had gained the trust of three more beauties, who now regarded him as if he were some kind of god.
"They are going to explode," said Saintess Val, who had now gained Kent’s trust and become his servant, finally reverting back to her extroverted yet rude self again.
"They can explode for all I care. Where I’m from, when you gift someone something, you can’t take it back anymore," Kent smiled, now resting his head on Selene’s chest.

The three ladies had been introduced to all of his companions, and after 10 hours of being shocked beyond their understanding, they now seemed okay watching him get intimate with the others around them.
"What are you going to do with the bodies, anyway?" asked Gate Master Mara, who had insisted Kent call her Big Sister Mara.
"You’ll see soon enough. For now, I have to focus on the auction, and under no circumstances should any of you fear them.
I know they’re dangerous, but they’ve also lost many powerful warriors, so they’ll be scared of us now.
Plus, you all know today things will be different, so let’s pay more attention to the items being auctioned."
The ladies nodded, understanding his reasoning and plan. Indeed, now that the warriors they sent after Kent wouldn’t return, they could only seeth in silence and fear him at the same time.
They would think twice before coming after him again.
But that didn’t mean they still didn’t hate him. In fact, if one were to look at the expressions on their faces, they would see the shock written all over them.
As for the two neighbors, the Millers and the Faywoods, they were staring at Kent and his ladies with their anger visible on their faces.
They were all pissed but also scared.
They knew they weren’t the only ones seething, but they also didn’t want to do anything stupid. If dozens were dead, it meant someone or something was at play here.

So they decided to stay away from him and his ladies for the remaining two days of the auction. The rising star of the Divine Palace sect was no simple person; they had just learned that the hard way.
If, in the future, another chance presents itself, they will do everything in their power to kill him.
A couple of minutes after Kent and his ladies arrived, Alina walked onto the stage with a smile on her face.
The ladies beside Kent knew why she was so cheerful. Alina had been called into the tower after Kent dealt with the assassins.
She was introduced as his lady, and when everything was done, Kent took her away to reward her for doing a good job as an auctioneer.
So, watching her smile happily as she climbed the stage, they knew exactly why.
Kent just smirked and chose not to bask in his glory today. If three hours of intense sex could make her this happy, then he was happy to help.
"Welcome, everyone, to the second day of the annual auction. I hope your nights were as good as we expected," Alina said, greeting those feeling enthusiastic about the second day of the auction.
Of course, the teasing in her statement was like a hot iron pressed against some people’s faces.
She was being petty, and Kent, who had planned to spend the night with her again, now decided to make sure she passed out and would be late for her last day.
The lady made sure to rub salt in the wounds of those who hadn’t had a good night’s sleep because of their life choices.
"Well, I had a great night, so why don’t we get the second day of the auction started?" She looked around the hall.
"The same rules still apply, so let’s do well to observe them." She returned her gaze to the mechanized table that had appeared, holding the next item.
"For our first item, we have a Heaven-grade spell that utilizes the power of lightning. It can be cast using any spell circle, provided you have the energy to harness a Heaven-grade spell."
"Bidding is set at 500,000 spirit stones, with a minimum increment of 10,000."
"The bidding starts now."
Just like that, the second day began with a Heaven-grade spell, and the bidding erupted into a frenzy.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: Dragon Scale Armor {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: The second day of the auction was different from the first day.
The items being auctioned are all in the heaven grade, so every item turns into a bidding war with the rich buying everything provided it holds any value to them.
A series of items were brought up for auction, with many bidding for their chances.
Kent and his ladies joined a few bidding wars, which they won simply because they had the money to call any bid.
Kent bought a rusted heaven-grade spear brought back from the Ancient battlefield of parting. It was broken, but it was in no way ordinary.
He wasn’t after the spear; he was more interested in the material used to make it.
The metal used in making the spear wasn’t something he could look down on, so after a brief battle, he won it for 120 million.
It appeared he wasn’t the only one who valued the spear.

Elsa also bid on an item. It was a peculiar item called a soul-tuning fork. To her, it would help her greatly in her soul cultivation, so she went for it. Strangely, some other person also bid on the item, but Elsa won.
Unity also won a bid on an arrow.
This arrow was also brought back from the Ancient Battlefield of Parting, but it wasn’t on the same level as the one Kent got from the store lady in the Green Gate bazaar.
The two gate masters also won some bids, with Lilian being the only one who did not have a chance to win anything. None of the items suited her.
Ingrid also bought an item, and so did her master, Neomi.
After 44 items, everything was settled for the heaven-grade items.

"Next, we have a heaven-defying pill and four legendary-grade items. Now, three of the items are indeed legendary grades. However, the last item in that category was given that grade simply because we don’t know its true grade.

Now, before you all start asking questions, know that despite us not knowing its true value, it is in no way useless. If anything, this should be something you should chase after with all your money."
Alina’s words made everyone eager to see what this item was.
They were all hyped and wanted to bid on the legendary-grade item and the pill, even though they knew little about them.
"I won’t talk too much, so why don’t we start with the first legendary-grade item?"
The mechanized table appeared, and hanging atop it was a green armour set, shining and illuminating the auction hall.

The faces staring at the armour narrowed their eyes as the armour immediately caught their attention. One didn’t need the genius to tell them that the armour hanging on the table was something everyone must have.
"This is the Dragon Scale Armor. It was found inside an armour protection case while exploring the dangerous parts of the Forbidden Grounds.
From what was discovered by the brave explorers, this armour was crafted by a renowned blacksmith you all might have heard stories of—Metal Sage Lore."
Alina paused as she mentioned the name everyone had heard before. He was one of the many figures whose stories were preserved before the Parting and the world divisions.

"Metal Sage Lore? Wasn’t he the one who crafted the current door protecting the Ancestral Burial Ground? I heard he was a close friend of the then-emperor of the human continent before the Parting," someone said.
Everyone began sharing their own versions of the stories, recounting how they had heard of him and what they knew. In all the tales, one thing was clear: Metal Sage Lore was a renowned blacksmith.
"Yes, this armour was crafted by Metal Sage Lore, the same human who was on the same level as the then-blacksmith of the Forbidden Grounds.
This armour is a masterpiece that boosts one’s strength by 30% when worn and enhances one’s defence by 50%.
In fact, under normal circumstances, one should know that with just this armour absorbing a hit, the energy stored can be released in a beam of energy."
"The bidding starts at 100 million, with a minimum increment of 10 million.
Let the bidding begin," Alina declared, and the whole auction house erupted into a frenzy.
"200 million..."
"300 million..."
"350 million..."
The price quickly rose, and everyone began to see the allure of such armour. Kent, seated in VIP room 13, scanned the armour.
⟪Name: Dragon Scale Armor ⟫
⟪Grade: Legendary ⟫
→ An armour crafted by Metal Sage Lore. Both males and females can wear it, as it adapts to their size and shape.
→ The wearer gains a 30% boost in strength and a 50% boost in defence.
→ Additionally, the wearer gains the ability to redirect all stored energy in the armour into a single beam that can kill anyone below the Root Ascension stage.
→ If you have a strand of dragon blood in you, the armour will bestow a skill called Dragon Strength.
→ This skill will grant you a 90% boost in strength and a 40% chance to ignore all defences and deal true damage.
’Not a bad item, but I already have a soul armor. And it’s not like I need a boost when I have stat points,’ Kent thought to himself.
Then he glanced to his left and noticed the two gate masters were interested in the armour, which would benefit them greatly.
"I don’t want it, so if you ladies want it, just bid. But there’s only one armour, and there are two of you, so decide who gets to have it,"
Kent said, knowing they were still hesitant about paying more than 500 million for a single armour set.
The price had already risen to a new high, so they wanted to confirm their decision before joining the bid.
"You can have it," Gate Master Mara said to her friend, who smiled and joined the bid.
"700 million!" she shouted, adding 100 million to the current price. However, the bidding didn’t stop because of her bid.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
After all, the armour was a legendary-grade item. Everyone wants to get their hands on it, especially the blacksmiths.

chapters.title: Chapter 297: Offer from a Sword King
paragraphs: "900 million..." Gate Master Camilla said, now locked in a bidding war against four people, each refusing to back down from the fight.
The allure of owning the dragon scale armour was something they wouldn’t let slip away easily. Kent sat quietly in his chair, staring at the Gate Master, who was playing it safe.
In her eyes, she wouldn’t repeat what Kent had done on the first day when he placed a bid and, just to provoke some people, chose to increase it unnecessarily.
She was prepared to battle them until the last second.
Right now, the four bidders, unsure if they could push the bid into the billions, began to realize this round might not be theirs—yet they couldn’t bring themselves to back down.
"1 billion," a figure in VIP Room 39 announced, causing everyone to inhale sharply. The price had entered the billions, and they all knew this was where most bids typically ended.
"1.1 billion!" Gate Master Camilla shouted, and all eyes turned toward Kent’s VIP room.
They could tell he was inside, but he wasn’t bidding, meaning he had withdrawn from the race before it even began. However, one of the ladies accompanying him was determined not to back down.
"1.2 billion," the figure in VIP Room 39 declared again, throwing in his bid. But it was futile, as the Gate Master was swimming in someone else’s money.

"I bid 10 billion."

"Ten billion? Just where is this brat getting his money from? Ten billion is more than enough to buy three Legendary-grade items," someone shouted, causing others to nod in agreement.
"This brat sure has some money. I wonder who his backer is," another person said.

"Haven’t you heard? Last night, some people went after him, but here he is, alive and breathing. Rumor even has it that the assassins sent after him never returned. So, as for his backer, only the heavens know."
"I know this brat. He’s the same guy who defeated the Sword Saint from the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect in a sword duel."
"No way. So, he’s the monster from the Divine Palace Sect? The one people are saying to look out for in the upcoming sect competition?"
"Yes, the same person. I wonder what his background is."

chapters.title: Chapter 298: No, He Did Not
paragraphs: A legendary grade item has just been sold, but instead of everyone talking about that, their focus was rather shifted to a different thing, and it was Kent’s short conversation with the sword king.
That is more shocking than the ten billion that had just been spent.
They clearly heard him call the mysterious figure Sword King, and the person didn’t reject his claims, which meant they were true. He was indeed a sword king, and somehow, Kent figured it out,
But that can be pushed aside.
What couldn’t be pushed aside was the fact that the sword King had invited Kent to a drink to talk about the sword.
That, that right here, is something that cannot be ignored.
"Did he just have a casual conversation with a Sword King and even get an invite to have a drink with him?" someone from one of the VIP rooms asked.
"No, he did not...right?"
But it was true.
Kent had just received an invite from a Sword King, someone at a level many would kill to reach.
Not only had Kent gained an invite from one of the three Sword Kings, but from the way they spoke, it was clear that the Sword King held no malice toward him despite being outbid.
Inside VIP room 13, the ladies turned toward Kent with shocked expressions.
"What?" Kent asked with a cheeky smile.
"You just got an invite from a Sword King. Why aren’t you shocked?" Gate Master Mara asked.

"Because he threw out bait, and I fell for it, so why look shocked? Plus, he’s a senior and the owner of the armor, so in a way, this is something he should be more pleased about than me," Kent said, shocking the ladies.
"Wait, he’s the owner of the armor?" Gate Master Camilla asked.
"Yes. I could tell from the way he was bidding—he wasn’t really aiming to buy. He was just baiting me to buy, and well, I fell for it. But I think his endgame was to invite me to a sit-down."
"But why? Why would someone like him invite a mere Sword Grandmaster to sit down with him? This just doesn’t make sense," Saintess Val said, voicing what everyone was hesitant to say.𝕗𝚛𝚎𝚎𝐰𝗲𝗯𝗻𝚘𝚟𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝕞
In the grand scheme of things, Kent was insignificant compared to a Sword King. So why, then, invite him?
"Have you ever heard the saying, ’Birds of a feather flock together’?" Kent said, almost breaking into resounding laughter.
"Are you saying you and he are on the same level?" Saintess Val asked again. Though her statement sounded rude, she was right to ask that.
Kent is a junior, so why would a senior invite him to have a sit-down? He clearly wasn’t on the same level as him.
"Nope. I cannot measure up to him in any way. However, when it comes to intellect, though I am still a junior, he could tell I am someone worth talking to.
So don’t be jealous, my dear servant. If you are a good girl, I will ensure you one day rise to my level," Kent said.
He had received the next quest after making her his servant, so, as he said, he would make her someone worthy of respect no matter where she found herself.
But the shameless way he said it left the ladies smirking.
The ladies rolled their eyes, but they would need some time to adjust to the sudden turn of events.
Kent just sighed and leaned back, placing his head on Selene’s chest. His head rested on her boobs, causing the gate masters to look at him weirdly.
The bait set by the Sword King was rather genius.
Kent would be lying if he said he expected this. During the war between the Sword King and Gate Master Camilla, he had, from time to time, felt a gaze fall on him.
At first, he pegged it as one of those idiots who came after him the night before. But as time went by and it kept returning, he started to get interested.
Then Alina suggested that he show off and perhaps that will allow him to meet the real owner of the auction house.
So he just assumed this was a win for him.
However, when he spoke those lines of text before he placed the bid, he felt the gaze in full form, and for a moment, he hesitated.
But then he just went for it, and the outcome now brought the auction to a halt.
"This year’s auction is showing more than we paid for. I am okay already, even if today was the last day. Being in the same room with a Sword King is already asking too much."
"True, I am already accomplished. If I were to die right now, I wouldn’t have any complaints."
The people started making their shameless remarks, and for a moment there, one could tell they were indeed happy.
Twenty minutes after the first legendary item was sold, the next was brought, and this time, the war lasted for only 40 minutes before the item was bought for 700 million.
It was a cloak that hid a person’s presence for a given amount of time.
The person who bought it was a young lady who, when Kent spied on her using his eyes, appeared to have a presence that was non-existent.
It was like she wasn’t alive, yet alive at the same time. He knew someone like her would be a terrifying assassin who could not be underestimated.
Then, the next item was brought, and that also sold for 950 million. This was a dagger that was bought by the same lady.
One could say she came for those two items, considering they were all things any assassin would cherish.
The dagger allows her to ignore 60% of the defense and deal true damage that, in no way, will make one’s skin crawl.
This time, Kent paid more attention to the lady and made sure she was fully captured in his mind before he pulled away.
The lady, who sensed someone spying on her, smirked and looked in Kent’s direction.
"We will meet in the sect competition, Monster of the Sword Gate," she muttered coldly.
After the last item was sold, a pill was brought to the stage, and after just the first line of speech, the entire auction hall became wild.

chapters.title: Chapter 299: Pill From the Perfect Alchemist
paragraphs: "Up next, we have a Tier 3 Flawless Pill from the Perfect Alchemist."
Alina said, and everyone went quiet, their expression aimed at the small jade box sitting on the mechanized table.
They all heard of the perfect alchemist simply because the pills he brought out in Caprath City were all 100% pure.
These pills are like gold mines, so there was even an auction for them in Caprath City. It was also the reason why Alina managed to secure the position of perfect alchemist this time around.

Not even the owner of the auction house knew of the identity of the perfect alchemist, so to think a new pill had appeared and it was even Tier 3, they all wanted to hear its effect and, perhaps, try to bid.
"The perfect alchemist, he had a new pill. The last time I heard his pills appear was in Caprath city and it was bought by the sword Saintess from the Divine Palace Sect...A new pill appeared again."
The people were hungrily waiting for Alina to tell them the nature of the pill and what it could do.𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮
"Before I tell you the name of the pill, I have a message from the perfect Alchemist," Alina said, scanning the room.
"He said and yes, the perfect alchemist is a he. Actually, he is just a young boy who is not older than 20.
He said he would be making his appearance in the upcoming Pill Master Competition in this same city a month from now.
He will be participating so if you want to know him, do well to be in attendance"
Alina exaggerated a bit, but she got the message out, and everyone took it in like it was the most important information they had ever heard.
"Now to the pill. It’s an Innate Talent Awakening Pill. And as you all know, Innate pills are basically about one’s talent.

Well, this pill is the same. Just like you all know, if this were to be a Tier 9 or 10, which I know only a few had even heard of, then know that this pill does similar work but in a toned-down version.
This pill enhances your talent, which enhances your spirit roots and helps you break through bottlenecks.

Yes, those stuck at the Root Grandmaster stage can become Root Saints, and Root Saints can become Root Sages. lastly, according to the Perfect Alchemist, those stuck at the Root Sage stage can become Root Great Sages after taking this pill.
And the best part, your talent, which will be upgraded to help you break through, will be permanent. So, unlike the realm ascension Pill, this pill affects you permanently.
So like I said, this will help you breakthrough and along with that, you will gain a boost on your Cultivation and Comprehension abilities"
"The bidding is set for 400,000 and there can only be a minimum of 10,000 increment."
"Let’s start bidding now"
Alina wasn’t even done when someone raised the price by a whopping hundred thousand. But he wasn’t the only one...
"One Million..." Another person said, just like them, the war started with the price rising steadily.
It’s just a Tier 3 Pill, but it’s a 100% pure pill, something nobody will pass up on. In fact, the alchemists around are all chasing after the pill for two things.
They wanted to study to see if they could understand how he managed to remove all the impurities. Alchemists have ways of knowing that.
Though it’s not guaranteed, they can make a breakthrough, and this will help them improve the purity of their own pills.
The second was the pill recipe.
Innate Talent Awakening Pill is one of the rarest pills an alchemist can make. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that no alchemist on this human continent has this recipe.
But they know what the pill is and they know what the real deal can do.
But they have no idea what the recipe is, and so they are now battling to see if they can get the recipe from the pill and perhaps try concocting it.
"5 million," someone said, but he was overtaken the next second.
Inside VIP room 13, Kent was lying comfortably in Selene’s embrace, watching as people bid on the pill.

"When did you make this pill?" Selene asked. Among his ladies, only she, Lilian, Elsa, and Unity truly believed Kent was an alchemist. The others just didn’t believe someone like Kent could be an alchemist.
In their eyes, he was too young to be capable of concocting pills.
But hearing Selene’s question, they all turned toward him.

"A couple of weeks ago. I just wanted to try my hand at a Tier 3 pill before the competition, and well, I succeeded after three tries... yay," Kent said, making the ladies still look at him strangely.
"Fine, here you go," Kent said, taking out four pillboxes containing pills from his space ring and handing them to the ladies.
"These—these are all perfect pills!" Gate Master Camilla almost shouted. Thankfully, the noise cancellation had been enabled, so it blocked her voice from escaping the room.
"Are you shocked, impressed, and charmed?" Kent asked, causing the Gate Master to blush slightly. The look on Ingrid, Neomi, Val, and Mara’s faces said it all; they were all shocked.
"How many talents do you have?" Gate Master Mara asked. The bidding war was still blazing hot.
"I am a man of many talents. Stick around, and you will find out," Kent said. He didn’t want to get into the technicalities now. The moment he entered her pants, she would know everything.
As for the master and her disciple, he had already told them, but they just didn’t believe him.
"How old are you, anyway?" Ingrid asked, already expecting a headache.
"I am 18, dear, but don’t worry—inwardly, though, I feel like I am over 30," Kent laughed, causing the ladies to look at him like they had seen a monster.
The bidding war, however, lasted for an hour until a certain Pill Grandmaster bought it for a whopping 90 million spirit stones.
Though the pill wasn’t on the same level as a legendary item, it was more than qualified to be on the same stage as them.
That was done, and the final item was brought out, shocking everyone.

So like I said, this will help you breakthrough and along with that, you will gain a boost on your Cultivation and Comprehension abilities"
"The bidding is set for 400,000 and there can only be a minimum of 10,000 increment."
"Let’s start bidding now"
Alina wasn’t even done when someone raised the price by a whopping hundred thousand.
But he wasn’t the only one...
"One Million..." Another person said, just like them, the war started with the price rising steadily.
It’s just a Tier 3 Pill, but it’s a 100% pure pill, something nobody will pass up on.
In fact, the alchemists around are all chasing after the pill for two things.
They wanted to study to see if they could understand how he managed to remove all the impurities.
Alchemists have ways of knowing that.
Though it’s not guaranteed, they can make a breakthrough, and this will help them improve the purity of their own pills.
The second was the pill recipe.
Innate Talent Awakening Pill is one of the rarest pills an alchemist can make.
It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that no alchemist on this human continent has this recipe.
But they know what the pill is and they know what the real deal can do.
But they have no idea what the recipe is, and so they are now battling to see if they can get the recipe from the pill and perhaps try concocting it.
"5 million," someone said, but he was overtaken the next second.
Inside VIP room 13, Kent was lying comfortably in Selene’s embrace, watching as people bid on the pill.
"When did you make this pill?" Selene asked.
Among his ladies, only she, Lilian, Elsa, and Unity truly believed Kent was an alchemist.
The others just didn’t believe someone like Kent could be an alchemist.
In their eyes, he was too young to be capable of concocting pills.
But hearing Selene’s question, they all turned toward him.
"A couple of weeks ago.
I just wanted to try my hand at a Tier 3 pill before the competition, and well, I succeeded after three tries... yay," Kent said, making the ladies still look at him strangely.
"Fine, here you go," Kent said, taking out four pillboxes containing pills from his space ring and handing them to the ladies.
"These—these are all perfect pills!" Gate Master Camilla almost shouted.
Thankfully, the noise cancellation had been enabled, so it blocked her voice from escaping the room.
"Are you shocked, impressed, and charmed?" Kent asked, causing the Gate Master to blush slightly.
The look on Ingrid, Neomi, Val, and Mara’s faces said it all; they were all shocked.
"How many talents do you have?" Gate Master Mara asked.
The bidding war was still blazing hot.
"I am a man of many talents.
Stick around, and you will find out," Kent said.
He didn’t want to get into the technicalities now.
The moment he entered her pants, she would know everything.
As for the master and her disciple, he had already told them, but they just didn’t believe him.
"How old are you, anyway?" Ingrid asked, already expecting a headache.
"I am 18, dear, but don’t worry—inwardly, though, I feel like I am over 30," Kent laughed, causing the ladies to look at him like they had seen a monster.
The bidding war, however, lasted for an hour until a certain Pill Grandmaster bought it for a whopping 90 million spirit stones.
Though the pill wasn’t on the same level as a legendary item, it was more than qualified to be on the same stage as them.
That was done, and the final item was brought out, shocking everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Skull of a Peak Root Sovereign Spirit Beast {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: The last item for the second day was something that, when brought out, shook everyone. Nobody expected something like that to be sold on the second day of the auction.
It just shouldn’t be sold yet.
But here it sat on the mechanized table—a colossal head of a spirit beast crackling with lightning, and the energy surrounding it was just too powerful.
It was as if a terrifying beast had appeared inside the auction hall the moment it was unveiled.

"This is the skull of a Peak Root Sovereign Spirit Beast, a beast just a step away from reaching the level of the Kingdom Protectors. It was discovered in the Wild Forest, and from what you all can sense, yes, this was a lightning-type beast.
It was a Metal-Skinned Storm Lion, one of the most powerful beasts out there, and its affinity for lightning is unparalleled."
Everyone took in a cold breath, feeling the pressure in the air.
The allure of having something like this is just too much to handle. In fact, having this in front of you has more than a 70% chance of helping you learn lightning and gain affinity.
Aside from that, cultivating the energy inside it will have more than enough benefits. It can also take someone from the Root Sage stage to the Root Transcendent stage.
It can also be used for alchemy, blacksmithing and a whole lot more.
Basically, the skull on the table, though not as strong as the original beats when it was alive, is still enough to make heads turn and jaws hang wide open.
Everyone wanted to have the skull, but they also knew only one person could have it. It’s an auction, after all.
"As to what you want to do with it, I don’t know. But we all know something like this can have more than enough uses."
"The starting bid is set at 300 million spirit stones, and the minimum increment is 50 million."
"The bidding starts now."
"500 million!" someone shouted from one of the VIP rooms, also beating Alina from declaring the start of the bidding.
"800 million," another voice chimed in, and just like that, the final bidding war for the last item had begun.
Everyone was already freaking out when it appeared, so they were pouring their wealth into the bids.
If they are lucky, they will be able to win something before the big games arrive in a day time for the real bidding wars that can cause centuries of conflict between families.
Many knew they wouldn’t be able to win anything tomorrow, so they wanted to try their luck today.
New voices started to join, and familiar voices also shouted their bids.
The prices shot up to 1 billion in under a minute, but dozens of people continued to bid. The allure of having the skull of such a powerful beast was something they wouldn’t pass up on.
Inside VIP room 13, Kent was now seated upright, staring daggers at the skull.
The comfortable embrace of the lady behind him was no longer comfortable, at least not at the moment.
Something had appeared that if he was right, he would be rescuing the two ladies faster than he planned.

’Gaia, what are my chances of creating a Root Transcendent Undead subordinate by mixing three Transcendent human dead bodies, this skull, a hundred billion spirit stones, and some other stuff?" Kent asked.

Though Gaia had said that the only limitation he would experience when using his Creator Necromancy Sub Class was the cultivation stage limit of this world, if Kent had the necessary items, he could create a subordinate who would be at the peak of this world.
But that would require a lot.
So he wanted to know just how far this could take him. The skull is rather powerful from just staring at it.
⟪The master should know that creating something new is not as easy as upgrading it. Creation will require a great deal. However, the skull there is from a Root Sovereign Beast.
Although the energy inside it has diminished, mixing it with what you mentioned can indeed help you create a Root Transcendent-level undead capable of fighting Root Ascendents at the early stages.⟫
’Then does that mean if I wait and gather more, I can go even higher than this?’
⟪Yes. But the master should know that creating a being above the Root Great Sage stage would require more than you might imagine.

So, the best course of action would be to use this to create your first subordinate. Then, using their strength, you can venture into the Ancient Battlefield of Passing or wherever materials are found and gather more.
You can add as many materials as you want for a single subordinate, so don’t hold back on how much you spend on them.⟫
’Thanks, Gaia. I guess I will buy this from them yet again. I wonder how pissed they will become, especially those blacksmiths,’ Kent sighed.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
⟪The master has more at stake than them, so they can cry all they want.⟫
’Indeed,’ Kent smirked and decided to take the treasure off their hands.
First, however, he just sat there and watched the crazy battle go on for an hour, with the price entering ten billion spirit stones.
By then, only four people remained, and three were the same blacksmiths he bought the meteor from right under their noses.
The last one was somebody Kent hadn’t met yet. Though he could know their true identity, he just didn’t care, considering their presence was that of a Root Great Sage.
"Metal Saint Rocky and Andrew, can’t you let this junior have this?" Metal Saint Adolf said, referring to himself as a junior when, in fact, he is a senior.

"Tomorrow is the big day, and we all will have something to buy. Since I need this, why don’t you two let me have it?" Clearly, he wasn’t placing the third bidder alongside the two blacksmiths in his eyes.
"Sorry, Senior Adolf, but I need the skull for a piece I am working on. However, if we can come to an agreement, then one of us can buy it and we share. What do you think?"
Metal Saint Andrew said, causing the two blacksmiths to enter a contemplative state. The offer was actually sound.

The price of the item is now 12 billion, and they both can pay without feeling too much of a dent in their funds. In fact, they can even pay 40 billion each and still be able to bid on items again tomorrow.
So this offer was indeed a good one for them. If the three band together, they will be able to win this and share, just as they should have done yesterday.
But if they do this, Kent would be in trouble. Well, that is their thinking...
"I accept," Metal Saint Adolf said.
"I also accept," Metal Saint Rocky said.
Kent, who didn’t expect this, smiled and asked Gaia a question, ’Gaia, how much do I have in my accounts?’
⟪The master is still very rich.⟫
’Well then, it’s time to end the day with a bang,’ Kent smirked and made his voice known.
"Sorry, gentlemen, but this skull won’t be going home with you today," Kent said, smiling.
"I bid 20 billion."
And just like that, the real battle between Kent and the three blacksmiths was underway.
